Adakah anda telah melihat jadual baharu untuk minggu depan? Ya, perbincangan itu telah dipindahkan ke sebelah petang. Berapa jauh danau dari sini? Kira-kira satu jam berjalan kaki melalui hutan. Adakah sukar untuk bekerja dalam pasukan yang besar? Kadang-kadang, tetapi peranan yang jelas menjadikannya lebih mudah. Adakah komputer anda berfungsi semula? Ya, pembarasan telah menyelesaikan masalah itu. Siapa yang mengetuai projek ini tahun ini? Pengurus daripada jabatan pengelanan. Adakah anjing anda suka berjalan-jalan?
items.reference_en: What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Why are bees so important? They pollinate the plants that give us fruit and vegetables. Is the professor strict about deadlines? Very strict, so please do not submit anything late. Did you read the news this morning? Only the headlines. Was something important announced? When is the report due? At the end of the week, before the meeting. How was the trip to the coast? Beautiful. We walked along the beach every evening. Can we move the meeting to the afternoon? That works for me. I will tell the others. Did you save a backup of your files? Of course, I always keep a copy on another drive. Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. Have you planted anything in the garden? Some herbs and tomatoes on the balcony. Have you visited the new art gallery? Not yet, but I heard the paintings are impressive. Do you exercise before or after work? Usually in the morning, before the office opens. Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes. Do you ride your bicycle to work? When the weather is good, yes. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. How do solar panels produce electricity? They turn sunlight directly into electrical energy. Who built the old castle on the hill? Nobody knows for sure, but it is very old. When does the next bus leave? In ten minutes, from the stop across the street. How do you remember what you read? I write a short summary after each chapter. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources. Have you seen the new schedule for next week? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. How far is the lake from here? About an hour on foot through the forest. Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. Is your computer working again? Yes, the update fixed the problem. Who is leading the project this year? The manager from the design department. Does your dog like going for walks?

items.name: Filipino (Tagalog)
items.text: Paano ang biyahe sa baybayin? Napakaganda. Naglakad kami sa beach bawat gabi. Ano ang gusto mong kainin ngayong gabi? May simpleng bagay, marahil sopas at sariwang tinapay. Mas gusto mo ba ang pagbabasa ng libro o panonood ng pelikula? Libro, dahil kaya kong isipin ang kuwento. Talaga bang sulit ang pag-recycle? Oo, binabawasan nito ang basura at nakakatipid ng natural na yaman. Ano ang nagdudulot ng mga alon sa karagatan? Pangunahin, ang grabidad ng buwan sa tubig. Bakit tumaas ang presyo ng mga gulay? Napakainit ng tag-init, kaya maliit lang ang ani. Malayo ba ang airport sa sentro ng lungsod? Hindi naman, ang tren ay tumatagal ng mga kalahating oras. Nagbigay ba ang doktor ng anumang payo? Sabi niya, magpahinga at uminom ng maraming tubig. May itinanim ka ba sa hardin? Ilang damo at kamatis sa balkona. Mas mura ba ang pampublikong transport kaysa sa pagmamaneho? Kadalasan, at mas mabuti rin ito para sa kapaligiran. Nakabisita ka na ba sa bagong art gallery? Hindi pa, ngunit narinig ko na ang mga pintura ay kahanga-hanga. Nag-save ka ba ng backup ng iyong mga file? Syempre, palagi akong may kopya sa ibang drive. Kailan umalis ang susunod na bus? Sa loob ng sampung minuto, mula sa bus stop sa kabilang kalye. Ilang tubig ang iniinom mo araw-araw? Hindi sapat, dapat talaga akong uminom ng mas marami. Bakit ka nagkakaroon ng maraming pahinga habang nag-aaral? Nakakatulong ang maikling pahinga para mas mag-focus. Maaari ba nating ilipat ang pagpupulong sa hapon? Maganda iyon para sa akin. Sasabihin ko sa iba. Bakit mabagal ang internet ngayon? Nasira ng bagyo ang ilang kable sa lugar. Mahirap ba magtrabaho sa isang malaking grupo? Minsan, ngunit ang malinaw na papel ay nagpapadali. Mahigpit ba ang propesor sa mga deadline? Sobrang mahigpit, kaya mangyaring huwag magsumite ng kahit ano na late. Bakit itinayo ang mga sinaunang lungsod malapit sa ilog? Nagbigay ang ilog ng tubig, pagkain, at transportasyon. Nabasa mo ba ang balita sa umaga? Lamang ang mga pamagat. May mahalagang anunsyo ba? Gaano katagal ang ginugol mo sa takdang-aralin? Karamihan sa hapon, dahil nagkamali ako sa simula. Bakit naantala ang flight? May makapal na fog sa maagang umaga. Sino ang nagturo sa iyo kung paano maghurno ng tinapay? Tinuruan ako ng aking lola noong bata pa ako. Ano ang anunsyo ng gobyerno? Isang bagong plano upang pagbutihin ang mga kalsada sa mga rural na lugar. Pupunta ka ba sa grupo ng pag-aaral ngayong gabi? Gusto ko, ngunit kailangan kong magtrabaho hanggang huli. Ano ang dapat nating dalhin para sa paglalakad? Tubig, pagkain, mapa, at isang mainit na damit. Mas maganda na ba ang pakiramdam mo ngayon? Mas maganda, salamat. Talagang nakatulong ang lahat. Mayroon ka bang tanong bago tayo matapos? Isa lang: kailan ang susunod na sesyon? Mag-uulan ba sa weekend? Sinasabi ng forecast na may magiging magaan na ulan sa Linggo. Nakita mo na ba ang isang balyena sa labas? Isang beses, mula sa isang bangka malayo sa dagat. Ano ang ibig sabihin ng mensaheng ito? Ibig sabihin, hindi mahanap ang file. Ikaw ba ay kinakabahan tungkol sa presentasyon? Medyo, pero sinanay ko na ito ng maraming beses. Maaari mo bang ipaliwanag muli ang huling halimbawa? Syempre. Hinahati natin ang data at ikumpara ang mga resulta. Bukas ba ang museo sa Lunes? Hindi, sarado ito sa Lunes ngunit bukas ang natitirang bahagi ng linggo. Nakita mo na ba ang bagong iskedyul para sa susunod na linggo? Oo, inilipat ang pagpupulong sa hapon. Nag-enjoy ka ba sa konsyerto kahapon? Sobrang saya. Napakaganda ng orkestra. Ano ang iniisip mo tungkol sa lektura ngayong umaga? Nakakainteres, lalo na ang bahagi tungkol sa data ng pagsasanay. Kumaron ka ba ng tren o bus? Ang tren, dahil mas mabilis at komportable. Gusto nating repasuhin ang mga pangunahing punto bago tayo matapos? Magandang ideya. Pag-usapan natin isa-isa. Paano mo nasusuyod ang pera? Naglalagay ako ng kaunti bawat linggo. Makakatuwa bang bisitahin ang festival? Oo naman. Dumadayo ang mga tao mula sa maraming bansa. Nais mo bang matutunan ang pangalawang wika? Oo, nagpraktis ako araw-araw gamit ang isang app. Gusto mo bang bumili ng bahay isang araw? Baka, pero sa ngayon mas madali ang pagrenta. Saan tayo dapat magkita bago ang pagsusulit? Magkita tayo sa harap ng aklatan, medyo maaga. Paano mo maalala ang nabasa mo? Sumusulat ako ng maikling buod pagkatapos ng bawat kabanata. Paano ka natulog kahapon? Hindi maganda. Naglalaro ang mga kapitbahay ng malakas na musika. Naiintindihan mo ba kung paano gumagana ang cross validation? Sa tingin ko. Sinusubukan mo ang modelo sa data na hindi pa nakikita. Gumagana na muli ang iyong computer? Oo, naayos ng update ang problema. Gaano kalayo ang lawa mula dito? Mga isang oras sa pamamagitan ng paglalakad sa gubat. Salamat sa iyong tulong ngayon.
items.reference_en: How was the trip to the coast? Beautiful. We walked along the beach every evening. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Books, because I can imagine the story myself. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources. What causes the tides in the ocean? Mainly the pull of the moon on the water. Why did the price of vegetables go up? The summer was very dry, so the harvest was small. Is the airport far from the city center? Not really, the train takes about half an hour. Did the doctor give you any advice? She told me to rest and drink plenty of water. Have you planted anything in the garden? Some herbs and tomatoes on the balcony. Is public transport cheaper than driving? Usually, and it is better for the environment too. Have you visited the new art gallery? Not yet, but I heard the paintings are impressive. Did you save a backup of your files? Of course, I always keep a copy on another drive. When does the next bus leave? In ten minutes, from the stop across the street. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. Why do you take so many breaks while studying? Short breaks help me concentrate for longer. Can we move the meeting to the afternoon? That works for me. I will tell the others. Why is the internet so slow today? The storm damaged some of the cables in the area. Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. Is the professor strict about deadlines? Very strict, so please do not submit anything late. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. Did you read the news this morning? Only the headlines. Was something important announced? How long did the homework take you? Most of the afternoon, because I made a mistake at the start. Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. Who taught you how to bake bread? My grandmother taught me when I was a child. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. Are you coming to the study group this evening? I would like to, but I have to work until late. What should we pack for the hike? Water, food, a map and a warm layer. Are you feeling better today? Much better, thank you. The rest really helped. Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? Will it rain this weekend? The forecast says there will be light rain on Sunday. Have you ever seen a whale in the wild? Once, from a boat far out at sea. What does this error message mean? It means the file could not be found. Are you nervous about the presentation? A little, but I have practiced it several times. Could you explain the last example again? Of course. We split the data and compare the results. Is the museum open on Mondays? No, it is closed on Mondays but open the rest of the week. Have you seen the new schedule for next week? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. Did you enjoy the concert last night? Very much. The orchestra was wonderful. What did you think of the lecture this morning? It was interesting, especially the part about training data. Did you take the train or the bus? The train, because it is faster and more comfortable. Shall we review the main points before we finish? Good idea. Let us go through them one by one. How do you manage to save money? I put aside a little every week. Is the festival worth visiting? Absolutely. People come from many countries. Have you ever tried learning a second language? Yes, I practice a little every day with an app. Would you like to buy a house one day? Maybe, but for now renting is easier. Where should we meet before the exam? Let us meet in front of the library a little early. How do you remember what you read? I write a short summary after each chapter. How did you sleep last night? Badly. The neighbors were playing loud music. Do you understand how cross validation works? I think so. You test the model on data it has not seen. Is your computer working again? Yes, the update fixed the problem. How far is the lake from here? About an hour on foot through the forest. Thank you for your help today.

items.name: Khmer
items.text: តើអ្នកអាចបកស្រាយឧត្តរចុងក្រោយម្តងទៀត?ច្បាស់ជាអ៊ីចឹង។ យើងចែករំលាយទិន្នន័យ និងប្រៀបធៀបលទ្ធផល។តើបច្ចេកវិជ្ជានិងកុំព្យូទ័រនឹងជំនួបការងារច្រើនទេ?មួយចំនួននៃការងារនឹងផ្លាស់ប្តូរ, ហើយការងារថ្មីៗនឹងមក។អ្នកបានទៅកន្លែងណាសម្រាប់ថ្ងៃបុណ្យ?យើងបានទៅទស្សនាភ្នំ.តើអ្នកអាចណែស៍កុបអញ្ចកល្អមួយបានទេ?ខ្ញុំបានបញ្ចប់កុបអញ្ចកមួយអំពីគ្រួសារមួយដែលបានចាកចេញទៅ។អ្នកចូលចិត្តអានសៀវភៅ ឬមើលហ្កីម?សៀវភៅ, ព្រោះខ្ញុំអាច ఊមរឿងដោយខ្លួនឯង។ខ្ញុំក៏មានបទពិសោធន៍ដូចគ្នា។ហេតុអ្វីបានជាទីក្រុងបុរាណត្រូវបានសាងសង់នៅជិតសមុទ្រ?សមុទ្រផ្តល់ទឹក, អាហារ, និងការដឹកជញ្ជូន។ដូចគ្នាដែរ.តើអ្នកមានអារម្មណ៍ខ្លាចអំពីការបង្ហាញទេ?តិចតួច, ប៉ុន្តែខ្ញុំបានធ្វើវាជាច្រើនដង។តើអ្នកបានចូលរួមក្នុងកម្មវិធីសំលាប់សំរាមនៅឆ្នេរ?បាទ, យើងបានប្រមូលកាបូបសំរាមជាច្រើន។វាមានន័យ។ហេតុអ្វីក៏មានអombangលើសមុទ្រ?ភាគច្រើនគឺអំពូលព្រះចន្ទលើទឹក។តម្លៃយន្តហោះត្រូវបានកាឡាយ?មានខ្យល់ធំនៅព្រឹក។អ្នកប្រាប់នៅសកលអញ្ចកទេ?ពិត, នៅថ្ងៃអង្គារយប់, ហើយគាត់នឹងសហរ។តើអ្នកអាចណែស៍រាយនោរមួយនៅជិតនេះបានដែរឬទេ?ទីតូចនៅកែងផ្លូវ ធ្វើមីល្អ។អ្នកបានយកឆ្កកមកពីណា?ពីសកលសង្គ្រោះសត្វនៅខាងក្រៅ។តើអ្នកបានស្នាក់នៅសណ្ឋាគារទេ?ទេ, មួយបន្ទប់ដែលមានទស្សនៈលើលក។ស្ដាប់បាន, ថ្លែងអរគុណ។ហេតុអ្វីបានជាអ៊ីនធឺណិតមានល្បឿនយឺតខ្លាំងណាស់ថ្ងៃនេះ?ខ្សែបានខូច ដោយព្យបោះ។តើផ្នែកណាដែលពិបាកបំផុតក្នុងការរៀនភាសា?និយាយដោយទំនុកចិត្ត, ជាពិសេសនៅលើទូរស័ព្ទ។កញ្ចែងព្រះអាទិត្យផលិតអគ្គិសិទ្ធិដោយរបៀបណា?ពួកវាបំរែបំរួលពន្លឺព្រះចន្ទទៅជាថាមពល។ខ្ញុំនឹងចាំ.អ្នកបានទៅមើលវិហារថ្មីដែរឬទេ?ទេ, ប៉ុន្តែខ្ញុំឮថា ឆ្នូតគឺអស្ចារ្យ។អ្នកបានរៀមអ្វីនៅវេទnesday?របៀបដែលបោកតអាចលំអរកញ្ចប់បានយ៉ាងលឿន។តើសារមន្មuseum ដំណើរការថ្ងៃច័ន្ទដែរឬទេ។ទេវ៉ា, វាបិទទ្វារនៅថ្ងៃច័ន្ទ ប៉ុន្តែបើកដំណើរការក្នុងថ្ងៃផ្សេងៗនៃសប្តាហ៍។ហេតុអ្វីការទំនាក់ទំនងល្អក៏សំខាន់ដែរ?ព្រោះការយល់ច្រឡំអាចបំផ្លាញបាន។តម្លៃថ្ងៃដំបូងនៅការងារថ្មី?ច្រើន, ប៉ុន្តែអ្នករួមការងារគឺរីករាយ។អ្នកមានអារម្មណ៍ប្រសើរជាងមុនថ្ងៃនេះដែរឬទេ?ខ្លាំងណាស់, ថ្លែងអ banyak។ វាពិតជាបាន។
items.reference_en: Could you explain the last example again? Of course. We split the data and compare the results. Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs? Some jobs will change, and new ones will appear. Where did you go on your summer holiday? We visited a quiet village near the mountains. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Books, because I can imagine the story myself. I had the same experience. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. Same here. Are you nervous about the presentation? A little, but I have practiced it several times. Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. That makes sense. What causes the tides in the ocean? Mainly the pull of the moon on the water. Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. Is the author giving a talk at the bookstore? Yes, on Thursday evening, and she will sign copies. Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby? The small place on the corner serves excellent noodles. Where did you adopt your cat? From the animal shelter on the edge of town. Did you book a room at the hotel? Yes, a room with a view of the lake. Good to know, thank you. Why is the internet so slow today? The storm damaged some of the cables in the area. What is the hardest part of learning a language? Speaking with confidence, especially on the phone. How do solar panels produce electricity? They turn sunlight directly into electrical energy. I will remember that. Have you visited the new art gallery? Not yet, but I heard the paintings are impressive. What did you learn at the science fair? How robots can sort packages very quickly. Is the museum open on Mondays? No, it is closed on Mondays but open the rest of the week. Why is good communication so important? Because misunderstandings can ruin a project. How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. Are you feeling better today? Much better, thank you. The rest really helped.

items.name: Burmese
items.text: ကျွန်ုပ်တို့ ပြီးဆုံးရန် မတိုင်မီ သင်၌ မေးခွန်းများ ရှိပါသလား။တစ်ခုသာရှိပါသည် - နောက်ထပ် အစည်းအဝေးက ဘယ်အချိန်ကျရောက်မည်သလဲ။နောက်ထပ် ဘတ်စ်ကားက ဘယ်အချိန် ထွက်သွားမှာလဲ။ဆယ် မိနစ်လောက်ကြာမှာပဲ၊ တဲလမ်းဘက်မှာရှိတဲ့ ဘတ်စ်ကားရပ်ကွက်ကနေ ထွက်သွားမှာပါ။ကောင်းမွန်သော ဆက်သွယ်ရေးသည် ဘာကြောင့် အရေးကြီးသလဲ။၎င်းသည် အကြောင်းအရာမေးခွဲမှုများသည် စီမံကိန်းတစ်ခုကို ပျက်စီးစေနိုင်သောကြောင့် ဖြစ်သည်။ကျွန်တော်က အဲဒါကို သတိထားမှတ်သားဦးမှာပါ။သင်က ပုဏ္ဍကောင်ကို ဘယ်နေရာက တည် Adoption လုပ်ခဲ့လဲ။မြို့ရဲ့အစွန်းမှာရှိတဲ့ တိရိစ္စံအကာအကူဌာနကနေရပါတယ်။အိမ်မှာ အမြဲတမ်း အစားအသောက် လုပ်လေ့ရှိလား။အများအားဖြင့် နေ့တိုင်းပါ။ ဒါက ကျန်းမာရေးအတွက် ကောင်းပြီး ဈေးလည်းသက်သာပါတယ်။သင်သည် ပျမ်းမျှကမ်းခြေသန့်ရှင်းရေးတွင် ပါဝင်ခဲ့ပါသလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ ကျွန်ုပ်တို့သည် အမှိုက်အိတ်အများအပြားကို စုဆောင်းခဲ့ပါသည်။ရှေးဟောင်း မြို့များသည် မြစ်များအနီးတွင် ဘာကြောင့် တည်ဆောက်ခဲ့ရသလဲ။မြစ်များသည် ရေ၊ အစားအစာနှင့် သယ်ယူပို့ဆောင်ရေးကို ပေးနိုင်ခဲ့သည်။စိတ်ဝင်တစားဖွယ် ဖြစ်ပါသည်။ ကျွန်ုပ်အား ပို၍ပြောပြပါလေ။အစိုးရက ဘာကြေညာထားလဲ။နယ်စပ်ဒေသရှိ လမ်းများကို တိုးတက်စေရန်အတွက် အစီအစဉ်သစ်တစ်ခုကို ကြေညာထားသည်။သင်ယူရန် အချိန်ယူခဲ့ရသလား။များသောအားဖြင့် ညနေပိုင်းအထိ ယူခဲ့ရပြီး၊ စတင်ချိန်၌မှားခဲ့သောကြောင့် ဖြစ်သည်။ကျွန်ုပ်က ယခင်ကပင် ထင်ထားခဲ့သည့်အတိုင်းပင် ဖြစ်ပါသည်။မနက်ဖြန်မှာ သတင်းတွေကို ဖတ်ကြည့်ခဲ့ပြီလား။ခေါင်းစဉ်တွေကိုသာ ဖတ်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။ အရေးကြီးတဲ့အချက်ကို ကြေညာထားပါသလား။ဒီနေ့ညမှာ ဘာစားချင်လဲ။အဆန်အသင့်စားရမယ့် အစားအစာမျိုးပေါ့၊ အထုပ်ကြော်နဲ့ အသစ်ထောင်းထားတဲ့ ခမီးရောင်ပေါင်မုန့်မျိုးပေါ့။သင်ရဲ့ ခွေးက လမ်းလျှောက်ရတာကို နှစ်သက်လား။သူက အထူးသဖြင့် မြစ်ကမ်းနားမှာ လမ်းလျှောက်ရတာကို နှစ်သက်ပါတယ်။ကျွန်ုပ်တို့ ပြီးဆုံးရန် မတိုင်မီ အဓိကအချက်များကို ပြန်လည်သုံးသပ်သင့်ပါသလား။ကောင်းမွန်သော အကြံပြုချက်ဖြစ်သည်။ ကျွန်ုပ်တို့သည် ၎င်းတို့ကို တစ်ခုချင်းစီကို ကြည့်ရှုကြပါစို့။၎င်းသည် တော်လှော်ဖွယ် ဖြစ်ပါသည်။ဒီအမှားအကြောင်းကြားစာက ဘာကို ဆိုတာလဲ။ဒါက ဖိုင်တစ်ခုကို မတွေ့နိုင်ဘူးဆိုတာကို ဆိုပါတယ်။ကျွန်ုပ်က ယခင်ကပင် ထင်ထားခဲ့သည့်အတိုင်းပင် ဖြစ်ပါသည်။ဒုတိယ ဘာသာစကား သင်ယူဖူးပါသလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ ကျွန်တော်က နေ့တိုင်း တစ်နေ့နည်းနည်းကို အက်ပ်တစ်ခုနဲ့ လေ့ကျင့်ပါတယ်။တောင်ပေါ်လမ်းတွေ ဆောင်းတွင်းမှာ ပွင့်နေလား။မဟုတ်ပါဘူး၊ ဒါတွေက များသောအားဖြင့် ဆောင်းတွင်းမှာ ဆူတေကြောင့် ပိတ်ထားပါတယ်။ညဘက်က ကောင်းကောင်း အိပ်ပျော်ခဲ့လား။မကောင်းခဲ့ပါဘူး။ အိမ်နီးအနားက လူတွေက သံသပ္ကို ကစားနေကြပါတယ်။ကောင်းတဲ့စာအုပ်ကို သင်က အကြံပြုနိုင်မလား။ကျွန်တော်က ခုနကပဲ မိသားစုတစ်စုက ပြည်ပကို ပြောင်းရွှေ့နေတဲ့အကြောင်း ပြောတဲ့ စာအုပ်တစ်အုပ်ကို ဖတ်ပြီးစီးပါတယ်။ဘယ်လိုမျိုး သီချင်းတွေကို ကြိုက်လဲ။များသောအားဖြင့် ငြိမ်းအေးတဲ့ သီချင်းတွေကို ကြိုက်ပါတယ်။ ဒါတွေက ကျွန်တော်ကို ပျော်ရွှင်စေပါတယ်။ဟင်းသီးဟင်းရွက်ဈေးနှုန်းတွေ တက်လာတဲ့အကြောင်း ဘာကြောင့်လဲ။နွေရာသီက အရမ်းခြောက်သွတ်ခဲ့လို့ ထွက်နှုန်းနည်းခဲ့ပါတယ်။သင့်ကွန်ပျူတာက ပြန်လည်အလုပ်လုပ်နေပြီလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ အပ်ဒိတ်လုပ်ပေးလိုက်တော့ ပြဿနာကို ဖြေရှင်းပေးပါတယ်။ဘာသာစကား သင်ယူရာမှာ အခက်အခဲဆုံးအပိုင်းက ဘာလဲ။ယုံကြည်မှုနဲ့ ပြောဆိုနိုင်တာ၊ အထူးသဖြင့် ဖုန်းနဲ့ ပြောတဲ့အခါမှာပါ။ဒီအပတေးတွင် မိုးရမလား။မျှော်လင့်ချက်အရ တနင်္လာနေ့တွင် မိုးရိပ်နည်းနည်း ရှိမည်ဟု မျှော်လင့်ထားသည်။နေ့စဉ် ဘယ်လောက် ရေ သောက်လဲ။လုံလောက်ပါးပါး မဟုတ်ပါဘူး၊ ကျွန်တော်က ပို၍ သောက်သင့်ပါတယ်။ကျွန်ုပ်သည် ၎င်းအပေါ်တွင် အမြဲတမ်း ယုံကြည်မှု မရှိပါ။ကြီးမားသော အဖွဲ့အစည်းတစ်ခုတွင် အလုပ်လုပ်ရန် ခက်ခက်ခဲခဲလား။အချို့အကြိမ်များတွင် ဖြစ်နိုင်သော်လည်း၊ တိကျသော အခန်းကဏ္ဍများသည် ပို၍လွယ်ကူစေသည်။ကျွန်ုပ်သည် ၎င်းအပေါ်တွင် အမြဲတမ်း ယုံကြည်မှု မရှိပါ။ညနေခင်းမှာ သို့မဟုတ် ညနေခင်းအလုပ်ပြီးတဲ့နောက်မှာ အားကစား လုပ်လေ့ရှိလား။များသောအားဖြင့် မနက်ပိုင်းမှာ၊ ညနေခင်းမှာ အလုပ်စလုပ်ခင်မှာပါ။သင်က ငွေကြေးတွေကို ဘယ်လို စီမံခန့်ခွဲပြီး စီးပွားဖြစ်အောင် လုပ်နိုင်လဲ။ကျွန်တော်က အနည်းငယ်ကိုပဲ အပတ်တိုင်း စီးဆင်းထားပါတယ်။ကျွန်ုပ်သည် ၎င်းနှင့် သဘောတူပါသည်။အင်ဂျင်နီယာများသည် ကားများကို လျင်မြန်စွာ အင်အားသုံးစွဲမှု လျှော့ချနိုင်အောင် ဘယ်လိုလုပ်နိုင်သလဲ။၎င်းတို့ကို ပို၍ပေါ့ပါးစေပြီး ပို၍ထိရောက်အောင် လုပ်ခြင်းဖြင့် ဖြစ်သည်။ကျွန်ုပ်က ယခင်ကပင် ထင်ထားခဲ့သည့်အတိုင်းပင် ဖြစ်ပါသည်။ကျွန်တော်တို့ အစည်းအဝေးကို မွန်းတည့်ချိန်သို့ ပြောင်းနိုင်မလား။ကျွန်တော်က အဆင်သင့်ပါတယ်။ ကျွန်တော် အခြားသူတွေကို ပြောပြပေးမယ်။ယနေ့မနက်ပိုင်းက ဟောပြောပွဲကို ဘယ်လိုမြင်ခဲ့လဲ။စိတ်ဝင်စားဖွယ်ကောင်းခဲ့ပြီး၊ အထူးသဖြင့် ဒေတာသင်ယူခြင်းအပိုင်းသည် အရေးကြီးခဲ့သည်။သင့်အဖွဲ့က ဒီနေ့ စနေနေ့က မဲပွဲကို အနိုင်ရခဲ့လား။ဟုတ်တယ်၊ ကျွန်တော်တို့က နောက်ဆုံး မိနစ်ပိုင်းမှာ အနိုင်ရပါတယ်။တွဲဖက်ပါမ professor သည် ချိန်သတ်မှတ်ချက်များကို တင်းကြပ်စွာ လိုက်နာစေလေ့ရှိပါသလား။တင်းကြပ်စွာ လိုက်နာစေလေ့ရှိပါသည်၊ ထို့ကြောင့် အချိန်မီ ပေးသွင်းခြင်းမရှိသော အရာများကို မပေးသွင်းမီ သတိထားပါ။
items.reference_en: Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? When does the next bus leave? In ten minutes, from the stop across the street. Why is good communication so important? Because misunderstandings can ruin a project. I will remember that. Where did you adopt your cat? From the animal shelter on the edge of town. Do you cook at home very often? Almost every day. It is healthier and cheaper. Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. Interesting, tell me more. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. How long did the homework take you? Most of the afternoon, because I made a mistake at the start. Exactly what I was thinking. Did you read the news this morning? Only the headlines. Was something important announced? What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Does your dog like going for walks? He loves it, especially near the river. Shall we review the main points before we finish? Good idea. Let us go through them one by one. That makes sense. What does this error message mean? It means the file could not be found. Exactly what I was thinking. Have you ever tried learning a second language? Yes, I practice a little every day with an app. Are the mountain roads open in winter? No, they are usually closed because of the snow. How did you sleep last night? Badly. The neighbors were playing loud music. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. What kind of music do you enjoy? Mostly calm music that helps me relax. Why did the price of vegetables go up? The summer was very dry, so the harvest was small. Is your computer working again? Yes, the update fixed the problem. What is the hardest part of learning a language? Speaking with confidence, especially on the phone. Will it rain this weekend? The forecast says there will be light rain on Sunday. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. I am not so sure about that. Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. I am not so sure about that. Do you exercise before or after work? Usually in the morning, before the office opens. How do you manage to save money? I put aside a little every week. I agree with that. How can engineers make cars use less energy? By making them lighter and more efficient. Exactly what I was thinking. Can we move the meeting to the afternoon? That works for me. I will tell the others. What did you think of the lecture this morning? It was interesting, especially the part about training data. Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes. Is the professor strict about deadlines? Very strict, so please do not submit anything late.

items.text: क्या एक बड़े समूह में काम करना मुश्किल है? कभी-कभी, लेकिन स्पष्ट भूमिकाएँ इसे आसान बनाती हैं। क्या आप काम करने से पहले या बाद में व्यायाम करते हैं? आमतौर पर सुबह, जब कार्यालय खुलता है। क्या आपको क्रॉस वैलिडेशन कैसे काम करता है, यह समझ में आता है? मुझे लगता है। आप मॉडल को उस डेटा पर परीक्षण करते हैं जिसे आपने पहले नहीं देखा। आपने कल रात कैसे सोया? बुरा। पड़ोसी जोर-जोर से संगीत बजा रहे थे। इंजीनियर कारों को कम ऊर्जा का उपयोग करने के लिए कैसे बना सकते हैं? उन्हें हल्का और अधिक कुशल बनाकर। आप पढ़ाई करते समय इतनी बार ब्रेक क्यों लेते हैं? छोटे ब्रेक मुझे लंबे समय तक ध्यान केंद्रित करने में मदद करते हैं। परीक्षा से पहले हमें कहाँ मिलना चाहिए? आइए थोड़ा जल्दी पुस्तकालय के सामने मिलें। क्या आप कोई अच्छी किताब सुझा सकते हैं? मैंने हाल ही में एक उपन्यास पढ़ा है, जो एक परिवार के विदेश जाने के बारे में है। अंतिम परीक्षा में क्या शामिल होगा? हमने इस सेमेस्टर में जो कुछ भी पढ़ा है। क्या हम मुख्य बिंदुओं की समीक्षा करें इससे पहले कि हम समाप्त करें? अच्छा विचार। आइए, एक-एक करके देखें। क्या आप कभी घर खरीदना चाहेंगे? शायद, लेकिन अभी किराए पर लेना आसान है। समुद्र में ज्वार क्यों आते हैं? मुख्य रूप से पानी पर चंद्रमा का गुरुत्वाकर्षण। क्या आप आज शाम अध्ययन समूह में आ रहे हैं? मैं आना चाहता हूँ, लेकिन मुझे देर तक काम करना है। क्या मुझे एक मजबूत पासवर्ड का उपयोग करना चाहिए? निश्चित रूप से। एक लंबा वाक्यांश का उपयोग करें जिसे याद रखना आपके लिए आसान हो। बच्चे दोपहर में क्या कर रहे हैं? वे स्कूल के सामने एक बर्फ का आदमी बना रहे हैं। किसी भाषा को सीखने का सबसे कठिन हिस्सा क्या है? आत्मविश्वास से बोलना, खासकर फोन पर। क्या आपके पास समाप्त करने से पहले कोई प्रश्न हैं? बस एक: अगला सत्र कब है? आपने अपने गर्मी की छुट्टी में कहाँ गए थे? हमने पहाड़ों के पास एक शांत गाँव में यात्रा की। सौर पैनल बिजली कैसे उत्पन्न करते हैं? वे सीधे सूर्य के प्रकाश को विद्युत ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित करते हैं। विज्ञान मेले में आपने क्या सीखा? कैसे रोबोट बहुत जल्दी पैकेज को छाँट सकते हैं। क्या आपको आज सुबह का व्याख्यान पसंद आया? यह दिलचस्प था, खासकर प्रशिक्षण डेटा के बारे में। तट की यात्रा कैसी थी? सुंदर। हमने हर शाम समुद्र तट पर टहलने गए। क्या हमें बाजार से फल खरीदना चाहिए? हाँ, वहाँ का फल सुपरमार्केट में मिलने वाले फल से ज्यादा ताज़ा होता है। सब्जियों की कीमत क्यों बढ़ी? गर्मी बहुत शुष्क थी, इसलिए फसल कम हुई। यहाँ से झील कितनी दूर है? जंगल में पैदल चलकर लगभग एक घंटा। क्या आपने अगले सप्ताह के लिए नई समय सारणी देखी है? हाँ, बैठक दोपहर में स्थानांतरित कर दी गई। आज इंटरनेट इतना धीमा क्यों है? तूफान ने क्षेत्र में कुछ केबलों को नुकसान पहुंचाया। क्या पुनर्चक्रण वास्तव में प्रयास के लायक है?
items.reference_en: Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. Do you exercise before or after work? Usually in the morning, before the office opens. Do you understand how cross validation works? I think so. You test the model on data it has not seen. How did you sleep last night? Badly. The neighbors were playing loud music. How can engineers make cars use less energy? By making them lighter and more efficient. Why do you take so many breaks while studying? Short breaks help me concentrate for longer. Where should we meet before the exam? Let us meet in front of the library a little early. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. What will the final exam cover? Everything we have studied this term. Shall we review the main points before we finish? Good idea. Let us go through them one by one. Would you like to buy a house one day? Maybe, but for now renting is easier. What causes the tides in the ocean? Mainly the pull of the moon on the water. Are you coming to the study group this evening? I would like to, but I have to work until late. Should I use a stronger password? Definitely. Use a long phrase that is easy for you to remember. What are the children doing this afternoon? They are building a snowman in front of the school. What is the hardest part of learning a language? Speaking with confidence, especially on the phone. Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? Where did you go on your summer holiday? We visited a quiet village near the mountains. How do solar panels produce electricity? They turn sunlight directly into electrical energy. What did you learn at the science fair? How robots can sort packages very quickly. What did you think of the lecture this morning? It was interesting, especially the part about training data. How was the trip to the coast? Beautiful. We walked along the beach every evening. Should we buy fruit at the market? Yes, the fruit there is fresher than in the supermarket. Why did the price of vegetables go up? The summer was very dry, so the harvest was small. How far is the lake from here? About an hour on foot through the forest. Have you seen the new schedule for next week? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. Why is the internet so slow today? The storm damaged some of the cables in the area. Is recycling really worth the effort?

items.name: Bengali
items.text: কেন মৌমাছি এত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ? তারা আমাদের ফল এবং সবজি দেয় এমন গাছগুলোকে পরাগায়ন করে। সবজির দাম কেন বাড়লো? গ্রীষ্মকালে খুব বেশি খরা ছিল, তাই ফসল কম হয়েছে। আপনি কি কোনোদিন একটি বাড়ি কিনতে চান? সম্ভবত, তবে এখন ভাড়া নেওয়া সহজ। এই বছর প্রকল্পটি কে পরিচালনা করছেন? ডিজাইন বিভাগের ম্যানেজার। আপনি কি কোনো ভালো বইয়ের নাম সুপারিশ করতে পারেন? আমি সম্প্রতি একটি উপন্যাস শেষ করেছি, যেখানে একটি পরিবার বিদেশে চলে গেছে। আপনি কি কখনো অন্য কোনো ভাষা শেখার চেষ্টা করেছেন? হ্যাঁ, আমি প্রতিদিন একটি অ্যাপের মাধ্যমে একটু অনুশীলন করি। সত্যি? আমি এটা জানি না। আপনি কি দয়া করে শেষ উদাহরণটি আবার ব্যাখ্যা করবেন? অবশ্যই। আমরা ডেটা ভাগ করি এবং ফলাফল তুলনা করি। জেনে ভালো লাগলো, ধন্যবাদ। বাইরে আবহাওয়া কেমন? এটি ঠান্ডা এবং বাতাসপূর্ণ, তাই একটি গরম জ্যাকেট নিয়ে যান। আমি সে বিষয়ে খুব নিশ্চিত নই। রিসাইক্লিং সত্যিই কি মূল্যবান? হ্যাঁ, এটি বর্জ্য হ্রাস করে এবং প্রাকৃতিক সম্পদ সংরক্ষণ করে। ঠিক সেটাই আমি ভাবছিলাম। আপনি প্রতিদিন কত পানি পান করেন? যথেষ্ট নয়, আমি সত্যিই বেশি পান করা উচিত। সত্যি? আমি এটা জানি না। আমরা শেষ করার আগে আপনার কোনো প্রশ্ন আছে? শুধু একটি: পরবর্তী সেশনের সময় কখন? আপনার বিড়ালকে কি পার্কে নিয়ে যেতে ভালো লাগে? সে পছন্দ করে, বিশেষ করে নদীর কাছে। ফ্লাইট কেন বিলম্বিত হয়েছিল? সকালে কুয়াশা ছিল। আপনি কিভাবে আপনি যা পড়েন তা মনে রাখেন? আমি প্রতিটি অধ্যায়ের পরে একটি সংক্ষিপ্ত সারসংক্ষেপ লিখে রাখি। জেনে ভালো লাগলো, ধন্যবাদ। এখানে থেকে হ্রদটি কত দূরে? প্রায় এক ঘণ্টা, জঙ্গলের মধ্যে হেঁটে। আপনি আজ রাতে কি খেতে চান? কিছু সাধারণ, সম্ভবত স্যুপ এবং তাজা রুটি। সমুদ্রের জোয়ার-ভাটা কেন হয়? মূলত, জলের উপর চাঁদের আকর্ষণ। এটা দারুণ শোনাচ্ছে। আপনি কি আপনার ফাইলের ব্যাকআপ রেখেছেন? অবশ্যই, আমি সবসময় অন্য ড্রাইভের একটি কপি রাখি। পরীক্ষার সময় নোট ব্যবহার করার অনুমতি আছে কি? না, এবং ফোন বন্ধ রাখতে হবে। সত্যি? আমি এটা জানি না। আপনার দল কি শনিবারে ম্যাচ জিতেছে? হ্যাঁ, আমরা শেষ কয়েক মিনিটে জিতেছি। আপনি কি বই পড়া বা সিনেমা দেখা পছন্দ করেন? বই, কারণ আমি নিজে গল্প কল্পনা করতে পারি। শীতকালে পাহাড়ি রাস্তা খোলা আছে? না, সাধারণত বরফের কারণে বন্ধ থাকে। আপনি কি গতকাল সন্ধ্যায় সূর্যাস্ত দেখেছেন? হ্যাঁ, পুরো আকাশ কমলা এবং গোলাপী রঙে ভরে গিয়েছিল। ডাক্তার আপনাকে কোনো পরামর্শ দিয়েছেন কি? তিনি আমাকে বিশ্রাম নিতে এবং প্রচুর পানি পান করতে বলেছেন। এই বিকেলে বাচ্চারা কী করছে? তারা স্কুলের সামনে একটি বরফের স্তূপ তৈরি করছে। জেনে ভালো লাগলো, ধন্যবাদ। আমরা কি মিটিংটিকে দুপুরের দিকে সরিয়ে নিতে পারি? এটা আমার জন্য ঠিক আছে। আমি অন্যদের জানাব। আপনি আপনার বিড়ালকে কোথা থেকে সংগ্রহ করেছেন? শহরের প্রান্তে অবস্থিত পশু আশ্রয়কেন্দ্র থেকে। জেনে ভালো লাগলো, ধন্যবাদ। গণপরিবহন কি ব্যক্তিগত গাড়ি চালানোর চেয়ে সস্তা? সাধারণত, এবং এটি পরিবেশের জন্যও ভালো। জেনে ভালো লাগলো, ধন্যবাদ। আপনি কি আজকের অধ্যায়টি পড়েছেন? হ্যাঁ, আমি গতকাল রাতে পড়েছি, তবে দ্বিতীয় অংশটি কঠিন ছিল। আমারও একই অভিজ্ঞতা ছিল। আপনি কি আপনার সাইকেল দিয়ে কাজে যান? যখন আবহাওয়া ভালো থাকে, হ্যাঁ। আপনি আপনার কাজের কোন দিকটি সবচেয়ে বেশি পছন্দ করেন? একটি দলের সাথে কাজ করা, যারা ভালোভাবে যোগাযোগ করে। এখানেও। সরকার কী ঘোষণা করেছে? গ্রামাঞ্চলে রাস্তা উন্নত করার একটি নতুন পরিকল্পনা। সৌর প্যানেল কীভাবে বিদ্যুৎ উৎপাদন করে?
items.reference_en: Why are bees so important? They pollinate the plants that give us fruit and vegetables. Why did the price of vegetables go up? The summer was very dry, so the harvest was small. Would you like to buy a house one day? Maybe, but for now renting is easier. Who is leading the project this year? The manager from the design department. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. Have you ever tried learning a second language? Yes, I practice a little every day with an app. Really? I did not know that. Could you explain the last example again? Of course. We split the data and compare the results. Good to know, thank you. What is the weather like outside? It is cold and windy, so bring a warm jacket. I am not so sure about that. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources. Exactly what I was thinking. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. Really? I did not know that. Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? Does your dog like going for walks? He loves it, especially near the river. Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. How do you remember what you read? I write a short summary after each chapter. Good to know, thank you. How far is the lake from here? About an hour on foot through the forest. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. What causes the tides in the ocean? Mainly the pull of the moon on the water. That sounds wonderful. Did you save a backup of your files? Of course, I always keep a copy on another drive. Are we allowed to use notes during the exam? No, and phones must be switched off. Really? I did not know that. Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes. Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Books, because I can imagine the story myself. Are the mountain roads open in winter? No, they are usually closed because of the snow. Did you see the sunset yesterday? Yes, the whole sky turned orange and pink. Did the doctor give you any advice? She told me to rest and drink plenty of water. What are the children doing this afternoon? They are building a snowman in front of the school. Good to know, thank you. Can we move the meeting to the afternoon? That works for me. I will tell the others. Where did you adopt your cat? From the animal shelter on the edge of town. Good to know, thank you. Is public transport cheaper than driving? Usually, and it is better for the environment too. Good to know, thank you. Did you finish reading the chapter for today? Yes, I read it last night, but the second half was difficult. I had the same experience. Do you ride your bicycle to work? When the weather is good, yes. What do you like most about your work? Working with a team that communicates well. Same here. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. How do solar panels produce electricity?

items.name: Tamil
items.text: பேராசிரியர்கள் காலக்கெடு குறித்து கண்டிப்பானவர்களா? மிகவும் கண்டிப்பானவர்கள், எனவே தாமதமாக எதையும் சமர்ப்பிக்க வேண்டாம். அடுத்த வாரத்திற்கான புதிய அட்டவணையை நீங்கள் பார்த்தீர்களா? ஆமாம், கூட்டம் மதியத்திற்கு மாற்றப்பட்டது. நீங்கள் ரொட்டி செய்வது எப்படி என்று யாரேனும் உங்களுக்குக் கற்றுக் கொடுத்தார்களா? என் தாத்தா எனக்கு ஒரு குழந்தையாக இருக்கும்போது கற்றுக் கொடுத்தார். அது ஒரு நல்ல கருத்து. பொறியாளர்கள் கார்களை குறைந்த ஆற்றலைப் பயன்படுத்தும்படி செய்ய முடியுமா? அவற்றை இலகுவாகவும், திறமையாகவும் மாற்றுவதன் மூலம். நீங்கள் கடற்கரை சுத்தம் செய்யும் பணியில் தன்னார்வத் தொண்டராக இருந்தீர்களா? ஆமாம், நாங்கள் நிறைய குப்பை சேகரித்தோம். அது சரியானது. சூரிய மின் தகடுகள் மின்சாரத்தை எவ்வாறு உற்பத்தி செய்கின்றன? அவை நேரடியாக சூரிய ஒளியை மின் ஆற்றலாக மாற்றுகின்றன. உங்கள் கணினி மீண்டும் வேலை செய்கிறதா? ஆமாம், புதுப்பிப்பு சிக்கலை சரிசெய்தது. அது சரியானது. தயவுசெய்து கடைசி உதாரணத்தை மீண்டும் விளக்க முடியுமா? நிச்சயமாக. நாங்கள் தரவைப் பிரித்து முடிவுகளை ஒப்பிடுகிறோம். அது சரியானது. பொதுப் போக்குவரத்து ஓட்டுவதை விட மலிவானதா? பொதுவாக, அது சுற்றுச்சூழலுக்கும் நல்லது. நீங்கள் ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் எவ்வளவு தண்ணீர் குடிக்கிறீர்கள்? போதுமானதாக இல்லை, நான் உண்மையில் அதிக தண்ணீர் குடிக்க வேண்டும். எனக்கு அதே அனுபவம் இருந்தது. இந்த வருடம் திட்டத்தை யார் வழிநடத்துகிறார்கள்? வடிவமைப்புத் துறையின் மேலாளர். புதிய தரவுகளில் மாதிரி மோசமாக செயல்படுவதற்கான காரணம் என்ன? பயிற்சி எடுத்துக்காட்டுகளை கற்றுக்கொள்வதற்கு பதிலாக, அவை நினைவில் வைத்திருப்பதால். செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு பல வேலைகளை மாற்றியமைக்குமா? சில வேலைகள் மாறும், மேலும் புதிய வேலைகள் உருவாகும். நான் அதை ஒப்புக்கொள்கிறேன். விமான நிலையம் நகர மையத்திலிருந்து எவ்வளவு தூரத்தில் உள்ளது? இல்லை, ரயில் சுமார் அரை மணி நேரம் ஆகும். அது ஒரு நல்ல கருத்து. இந்த விழாவுக்குச் செல்வது மதிப்புள்ளதா? நிச்சயமாக. மக்கள் பல நாடுகளிலிருந்து வருகிறார்கள். அது சரியானது. இந்த நிரலுக்கு நான் உங்களுக்கு உதவ முடியுமா? நிச்சயமாக. முதலில் பிழை செய்தியைக் காட்டுங்கள். தெரிந்து கொள்வது நல்லது, நன்றி. உங்கள் வேலையில் உங்களுக்கு எது மிகவும் பிடிக்கும்? நன்கு தொடர்பு கொள்ளும் ஒரு குழுவுடன் பணிபுரிவது. நான் அதை பற்றி உறுதியாக இல்லை. கூட்டத்தை மதியத்திற்கு மாற்ற முடியுமா? அது எனக்குச் சரியானது. நான் மற்றவர்களுக்குச் சொல்வேன். நாம் முடிப்பதற்கு முன் முக்கிய புள்ளிகளை மதிப்பாய்வு செய்யலாமா? நல்ல யோசனை. ஒவ்வொன்றாக அவற்றை ஆராய்வோம். இன்று இணையம் ஏன் மிகவும் மெதுவாக உள்ளது? புயல் அந்த பகுதியில் உள்ள சில கேபிள்களை சேதப்படுத்தியது. நான் நினைத்த அதே. நாங்கள் மலையேற்றத்திற்கு என்ன கொண்டு வர வேண்டும்?
items.reference_en: Is the professor strict about deadlines? Very strict, so please do not submit anything late. Have you seen the new schedule for next week? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. Who taught you how to bake bread? My grandmother taught me when I was a child. That is a good point. How can engineers make cars use less energy? By making them lighter and more efficient. Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. That makes sense. How do solar panels produce electricity? They turn sunlight directly into electrical energy. Is your computer working again? Yes, the update fixed the problem. That makes sense. Could you explain the last example again? Of course. We split the data and compare the results. That makes sense. Is public transport cheaper than driving? Usually, and it is better for the environment too. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. I had the same experience. Who is leading the project this year? The manager from the design department. Why does the model perform badly on new data? Because it memorized the training examples instead of learning patterns. Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs? Some jobs will change, and new ones will appear. I agree with that. Is the airport far from the city center? Not really, the train takes about half an hour. That is a good point. Is the festival worth visiting? Absolutely. People come from many countries. That makes sense. Can you help me with this program? Sure. Show me the error message first. Good to know, thank you. What do you like most about your work? Working with a team that communicates well. I am not so sure about that. Can we move the meeting to the afternoon? That works for me. I will tell the others. Shall we review the main points before we finish? Good idea. Let us go through them one by one. Why is the internet so slow today? The storm damaged some of the cables in the area. Exactly what I was thinking. What should we pack for the hike?

items.name: Telugu
items.text: భాష నేర్చుకోవడంలో కష్టమైన భాగం ఏమిటి? నమ్మకంగా మాట్లాడటం, ముఖ్యంగా ఫోన్‌లో. మీరు పుస్తకాలు చదవడం లేదా సినిమాలు చూడడం ఇష్టపడతారా? పుస్తకాలు, ఎందుకంటే నేను కథను స్వయంగా ఊహించగలను. మీరు ఒక మంచి పుస్తకాన్ని సిఫార్సు చేయగలరా? నేను విదేశాలకు వెళ్ళే కుటుంబం గురించి ఒక నవలను పూర్తి చేసాను. నేను బలమైన పాస్‌వర్డ్‌ను ఉపయోగించాలా? ఖచ్చితంగా. మీకు గుర్తుంచుకోవడం సులభమైన పొడవైన పదబంధాన్ని ఉపయోగించండి. మనం ముగించే ముందు మీకు ఏమైనా ప్రశ్నలు ఉన్నాయా? కేవలం ఒకటి: తదుపరి సెషన్ ఎప్పుడు? ప్రభుత్వం ఏమి ప్రకటించింది? గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాల్లో రోడ్లను మెరుగుపరచడానికి ఒక కొత్త ప్రణాళిక. మీకు ఎలాంటి సంగీతం ఇష్టం? ఎక్కువగా ప్రశాంతమైన సంగీతం, ఇది నాకు విశ్రాంతినిస్తుంది. మీరు రైలు లేదా బస్సులో ప్రయాణించారా? రైలు, ఎందుకంటే అది వేగంగా మరియు సౌకర్యవంతంగా ఉంటుంది. మీ కుక్క నడకకు ఇష్టమా? అది చాలా ఇష్టం, ముఖ్యంగా నది దగ్గర. మీరు ఈ రోజు బాగానే ఉన్నారా? చాలా బాగా, ధన్యవాదాలు. మిగిలినవి నిజంగా సహాయపడ్డాయి. మీరు చదువుకునేటప్పుడు ఎందుకు అంత ఎక్కువ విరామాలు తీసుకుంటారు? చిన్న విరామాలు ఎక్కువసేపు దృష్టి పెట్టడానికి సహాయపడతాయి. మీరు పార్క్‌లో ఫుట్‌బాల్ ఆడాలనుకుంటున్నారా? బహుశా తరువాత, అది అంత వేడిగా లేనప్పుడు. మీరు వచ్చే వారం కోసం కొత్త షెడ్యూల్‌ను చూశారా? అవును, సమావేశం మధ్యాహ్నానికి మార్చబడింది. పురాతన నగరాలను నదుల దగ్గర ఎందుకు నిర్మించారు? నదులు నీరు, ఆహారం మరియు రవాణాను అందించాయి. బయట వాతావరణం ఎలా ఉంది? చల్లగా మరియు గాలి ఎక్కువగా ఉంది, కాబట్టి వెచ్చని జాకెట్ తీసుకోండి. ఈ మధ్యాహ్నం పిల్లలు ఏమి చేస్తున్నారు? వారు పాఠశాల ముందు మంచు మనిషిని నిర్మిస్తున్నారు. మీరు నిన్న రాత్రి ఎలా నిద్రపోయారు? సరిగ్గా లేదు. పొరుగువారు బిగ్గరగా సంగీతం ప్లే చేస్తున్నారు. మీరు ఒక రోజు ఇల్లు కొనాలనుకుంటున్నారా? బహుశా, కానీ ప్రస్తుతానికి అద్దెకు తీసుకోవడం సులభం. మీరు మీ పిల్లిని ఎక్కడ దత్తత తీసుకున్నారు? పట్టణం యొక్క అంచున ఉన్న జంతు ఆశ్రయం నుండి. మీరు నిన్న రాత్రి కచేరీను ఆస్వాదించారా? చాలా. ఆర్కెస్ట్రా అద్భుతంగా ఉంది.
items.reference_en: What is the hardest part of learning a language? Speaking with confidence, especially on the phone. Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Books, because I can imagine the story myself. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. Should I use a stronger password? Definitely. Use a long phrase that is easy for you to remember. Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. What kind of music do you enjoy? Mostly calm music that helps me relax. Did you take the train or the bus? The train, because it is faster and more comfortable. Does your dog like going for walks? He loves it, especially near the river. Are you feeling better today? Much better, thank you. The rest really helped. Why do you take so many breaks while studying? Short breaks help me concentrate for longer. Do you want to play football in the park? Maybe later, when it is not so hot. Have you seen the new schedule for next week? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. What is the weather like outside? It is cold and windy, so bring a warm jacket. What are the children doing this afternoon? They are building a snowman in front of the school. How did you sleep last night? Badly. The neighbors were playing loud music. Would you like to buy a house one day? Maybe, but for now renting is easier. Where did you adopt your cat? From the animal shelter on the edge of town. Did you enjoy the concert last night? Very much. The orchestra was wonderful.

items.name: Urdu
items.text: آپ کیسے یاد کرتے ہیں کہ آپ کیا پڑھ چکے ہیں؟ میں ہر ایک باب کے بعد ایک مختصر خلاصہ لکھتا ہوں۔ بالکل وہی جو میں سوچ رہا تھا۔ کیا ڈاکٹر نے آپ کو کوئی مشورہ دیا؟ انہوں نے مجھے آرام کرنے اور بہت زیادہ پانی پینے کی سفارش کی۔ اگلا بس کب جائے گا؟ دس منٹوں میں، اس اسٹاپ سے۔ کیا پروفیسر مقررہ وقت پر سخت ہیں؟ بہت سخت، لہذا براہ کرم کچھ بھی دیر سے نہیں بھیجیں۔ کیا آپ کو پریشانگی ہو رہی ہے؟ تھوڑا، لیکن میں نے اسے کئی بار آزمایا ہے۔ آپ پیسہ کیسے بچاتے ہیں؟ میں ہر ہفتے تھوڑا پیسہ جمع کرتا ہوں۔ میں اس بارے میں اتنا مت یقین رکھتا ہوں۔ رپورٹ کب جمع کرانی ہے؟ ہفتے کے آخر میں، میٹنگ سے پہلے۔ یہ منطقی ہے۔ کیا آپ کی ٹیم نے ہفتے میں میچ جیتا؟ ہاں، ہم آخر میں چند منٹوں میں جیت گئے۔ میں اسے یاد رکھوں گا۔ شمسی پینل بجلی کیسے پیدا کرتے ہیں؟ وہ براہ راست سورج کی روشنی کو الیکٹریکل توانائی میں تبدیل کرتے ہیں۔ کیا آپ نے آج کے لیے کاپی مکمل کر لی؟ ہاں، میں نے اسے گزشتہ رات پڑھی، لیکن دوسرا حصہ مشکل تھا۔ میں اسے یاد رکھوں گا۔ کیا آپ آج شام اسٹڈی گروپ میں آ رہے ہیں؟ میں ضرور آؤں گا، لیکن مجھے رات تک کام کرنا ہے۔ واقعی؟ مجھے اس کا علم نہیں تھا۔ کیا آپ نے ہوٹل میں کمرہ بک کیا؟ ہاں، ایک کمرہ جو دریا کو دیکھ سکے۔ یہاں بھی۔ ساحل تک سفر کیسے تھا۔ بہت خوبصورت۔ ہم ہر شام ساحل کے ساتھ چلتے تھے۔ میں اس سے Voulez-vous acheter une maison un jour ? Peut-être, mais pour l'instant, louer est plus facile. Avez-vous déjà vu une baleine dans la nature ? Une fois, depuis un bateau loin dans la mer. Pourriez-vous expliquer le dernier exemple encore une fois ? Bien sûr. Nous avons divisé les données et comparé les résultats. À quelle fréquence l'équipe s'entraîne-t-elle ? Deux fois par semaine, et plus avant les matchs importants. Préférez-vous lire des livres ou regarder des films ? Des livres, parce que je peux imaginer l'histoire moi-même. Allez-vous venir au groupe d'étude ce soir ? J'aimerais, mais je dois travailler jusqu'à tard. Dois-je utiliser un mot de passe plus fort ? Absolument. Utilisez une phrase longue que vous pouvez facilement vous rappeler. Avez-vous lu les nouvelles ce matin ? Seulement les titres. Y a-t-il eu une annonce importante ? Pouvez-vous me recommander un bon restaurant à proximité ? Le petit restaurant du coin sert d'excellents nouilles. Qu'en avez-vous pensé de la conférence de ce matin ? C'était intéressant, surtout la partie sur les données d'entraînement. Comment avez-vous dormi la nuit dernière ? Mal. Les voisins jouaient de la musique forte. Comment s'est passée votre première journée au nouvel emploi ? Occupé, mais mes collègues étaient très sympathiques. Avez-vous planté quelque chose dans le jardin ? Quelques herbes et tomates sur le balcon. Qu'est-ce qu'il faut emporter pour la randonnée ? De l'eau, de la nourriture, une carte et une couche chaude. Combien de temps vous a pris le devoir ? La majeure partie de l'après-midi, parce que j'ai fait une erreur au début. Est-il difficile de travailler dans une grande équipe ? Parfois, mais des rôles clairs facilitent les choses. Est-ce que vous comprenez comment fonctionne la validation croisée ? Je pense que oui. Vous testez le modèle sur des données qu'il n'a pas vues. Pourquoi les anciennes villes ont-elles été construites près des rivières ? Les rivières fournissaient de l'eau, de la nourriture et des moyens de transport. Quelle est la partie la plus difficile de l'apprentissage d'une langue ? Parler avec confiance, surtout au téléphone. Quand est la date limite pour le rapport ? À la fin de la semaine, avant la réunion. Comment faites-vous pour épargner de l'argent ? Je mets de côté un peu chaque semaine. Va-t-il pleuvoir ce week-end ? Les prévisions indiquent qu'il y aura de la pluie légère le dimanche. Le professeur est-il strict quant aux délais ? Très strict, donc s'il vous plaît, ne soumettez rien en retard. Merci pour votre aide aujourd'hui. De rien. À la semaine prochaine. Qui dirige le projet cette année ? Le responsable du département de design. Avez-vous déjà essayé d'apprendre une deuxième langue ? Oui, je pratique un peu tous les jours avec une application. Qui a construit le vieux château sur la colline ? Personne ne le sait avec certitude, mais il est très ancien. Qu'avez-vous appris lors du salon de la science ? Comment les robots peuvent-ils trier les colis très rapidement. Vous avez visité la nouvelle galerie d'art ? Non, mais j'ai entendu que les peintures sont impressionnantes. À quelle heure part le prochain bus ? Dans dix minutes, depuis l'arrêt en face. Votre chien aime-t-il se promener ? Il adore, surtout près de la rivière. Qui m'a appris à faire du pain ? Ma grand-mère m'a appris quand j'étais enfant. Votre équipe a-t-elle gagné le match le samedi ? Oui, nous avons gagné dans les dernières minutes. Avez-vous sauvegardé une copie de vos fichiers ? Bien sûr, je garde toujours une copie sur un autre disque. Avez-vous des questions avant de terminer ? Juste une : quelle est la prochaine séance ? Comment les ingénieurs peuvent-ils faire en sorte que les voitures consomment moins d'énergie ? En les rendant plus légères et plus efficaces. Avez-vous participé à la collecte de déchets sur la plage ? Oui, nous avons collecté de nombreux sacs de déchets. Avez-vous vu le nouveau planning pour la semaine prochaine ? Oui, la réunion a été reportée à l'après-midi. L'aéroport est-il loin du centre-ville ? Non, le train prend environ une demi-heure. Voulez-vous jouer au football dans le parc ? Peut-être plus tard, quand il ne fait pas trop chaud. Cuisine-vous souvent à la maison ? Presque tous les jours. C'est plus sain et moins cher. L'auteur donne-t-il une conférence dans la librairie ? Oui, jeudi soir, et elle signera des exemplaires. Qu'est-ce que vous aimeriez manger ce soir ? Quelque chose de simple, peut-être une soupe et du pain frais. Qu'est-ce que vous aimez le plus dans votre travail ? Travailler en équipe avec de bonnes capacités de communication. Les transports en commun sont-ils moins chers que la voiture ? Généralement, et c'est aussi mieux pour l'environnement. Pourquoi le vol a-t-il été retardé ? Il y avait beaucoup de brouillard tôt le matin. La fête vaut-il la peine d'être visitée ? Absolument. Des gens viennent de nombreux pays. Comment vous souvenez-vous de ce que vous lisez ? Je fais un bref résumé après chaque chapitre. Pourquoi le prix des légumes a-t-il augmenté ? L'été a été très sec, donc la récolte a été faible. Combien d'eau buvez-vous chaque jour ? Pas assez, je devrais vraiment en boire plus. Quel temps fait-il dehors ? Il fait froid et venteux, alors prenez un manteau chaud. Où êtes-vous allé pour vos vacances d'été ? Nous avons visité un village tranquille près des montagnes. Qu'est-ce qui cause les marées dans l'océan ? Principalement, la force de la lune sur l'eau. Que ont annoncé les gouvernements ? Un nouveau plan pour améliorer les routes dans les zones rurales. Utilisez-vous votre vélo pour aller au travail ? Quand le temps est beau, oui. Que signifie ce message d'erreur ? Cela signifie que le fichier n'a pas été trouvé. Quel sera le contenu de l'examen final ? Tout ce que nous avons étudié pendant ce semestre. L'intelligence artificielle remplacera-t-elle de nombreux emplois ? Certains emplois changeront, et de nouveaux apparaîtront. Quelle est votre saison préférée ? L'automne, quand les feuilles changent de couleur. Où devrions-nous nous rencontrer avant l'examen ? Allons nous rencontrer devant la bibliothèque un peu plus tôt. Pouvez-vous me recommander un bon livre ?
items.reference_en: Did you take the train or the bus? The train, because it is faster and more comfortable. How far is the lake from here? About an hour on foot through the forest. Thank you for your help today. You are welcome. See you next week. Who is leading the project this year? The manager from the design department. Have you ever tried learning a second language? Yes, I practice a little every day with an app. Who built the old castle on the hill? Nobody knows for sure, but it is very old. What did you learn at the science fair? How robots can sort packages very quickly. Have you visited the new art gallery? Not yet, but I heard the paintings are impressive. When does the next bus leave? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. Is the airport far from the city center? Not really, the train takes about half an hour. Do you want to play football in the park? Maybe later, when it is not so hot. Do you cook at home very often? Almost every day. It is healthier and cheaper. Is the author giving a talk at the bookstore? Yes, on Thursday evening, and she will sign copies. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. What do you like most about your work? Working with a team that communicates well. Is public transport cheaper than driving? Usually, and it is better for the environment too. Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. Is the festival worth visiting? Absolutely. People come from many countries. How do you remember what you read? I write a short summary after each chapter. What is the weather like outside? It is cold and windy, so bring a warm jacket. Where did you go on your summer holiday? We visited a quiet village near the mountains. What causes the tides in the ocean? Mainly the pull of the moon on the water. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. Do you ride your bicycle to work? items.name: German
items.text: Hast du den neuen Zeitplan für nächste Woche gesehen? Ja, das Treffen wurde auf den Nachmittag verschoben. Wer hat Ihnen beigebracht, Brot zu backen? Meine Großmutter hat mir das beigebracht, als ich noch ein Kind war. Wo haben Sie Ihren Kater adoptiert? Aus dem Tierheim am Stadtrand. Ist der öffentliche Nahverkehr günstiger als das Autofahren? Normalerweise, und es ist auch besser für die Umwelt. Haben Sie schon einmal versucht, eine zweite Sprache zu lernen? Ja, ich übe jeden Tag ein wenig mit einer App. Verstehst du, wie Kreuzvalidierung funktioniert? Ich denke schon. Du testest das Modell mit Daten, die es nicht gesehen hat. Wie viel Wasser trinken Sie täglich? Nicht genug, ich sollte wirklich mehr trinken. Was verursacht die Gezeiten im Meer? Hauptsächlich die Anziehungskraft des Mondes auf das Wasser. Wie haben Sie letzte Nacht geschlafen? Schlecht. Die Nachbarn haben laute Musik gespielt. Was ist der schwierigste Teil beim Sprachenlernen? Selbstbewusst zu sprechen, besonders am Telefon. Ist der Professor streng bezüglich der Fristen? Sehr streng, also bitte reiche nichts zu spät ein. Sind die Bergstraßen im Winter befahrbar? Nein, sie sind normalerweise wegen des Schnees gesperrt. Warum ist eine gute Kommunikation so wichtig? Weil Missverständnisse ein Projekt ruinieren können. Hast du beim Strandaufräumen mitgeholfen? Ja, wir haben viele Müllsäcke gesammelt. Können Sie ein gutes Buch empfehlen? Ich habe gerade einen Roman über eine Familie gelesen, die ins Ausland zieht. Warum ist der Preis für Gemüse gestiegen? Der Sommer war sehr trocken, daher war die Ernte gering. Wie war Ihr erster Tag in der neuen Arbeit? Aufregend, aber meine Kollegen waren sehr freundlich. Was hältst du von der Vorlesung heute Morgen? Es war interessant, besonders der Teil über Trainingsdaten. Wie ist das Wetter draußen? Es ist kalt und windig, also bringe eine warme Jacke mit. Sind Sie nervös wegen der Präsentation? Ein bisschen, aber ich habe es mehrmals geübt. Welche Themen werden die Abschlussprüfung abdecken? Alles, was wir in diesem Semester gelernt haben. Gibt es eine Lesung des Autors im Buchladen? Ja, am Donnerstagabend, und sie wird Exemplare signieren. Kommst du heute Abend zur Lerngruppe? Ich würde gerne, aber ich muss bis spät arbeiten. Bevorzugen Sie, Bücher zu lesen oder Filme anzusehen? Bücher, weil ich die Geschichte selbst mir vorstellen kann. Sollten wir Obst auf dem Markt kaufen? Ja, das Obst dort ist frischer als im Supermarkt. Können wir das Meeting auf den Nachmittag verschieben? Das passt für mich. Ich werde es den anderen sagen. Vielen Dank für Ihre Hilfe heute. Gern geschehen. Bis nächste Woche. Haben Sie ein Zimmer im Hotel gebucht? Ja, ein Zimmer mit Blick auf den See. Funktioniert Ihr Computer wieder? Ja, der Update hat das Problem behoben. Was bedeutet diese Fehlermeldung? Es bedeutet, dass die Datei nicht gefunden wurde. Kochen Sie sehr oft zu Hause? Fast jeden Tag. Es ist gesünder und günstiger. Wie können Ingenieure Autos energieeffizienter machen? Indem sie leichter und effizienter gemacht werden. Wie lange hat dir die Hausarbeit gedauert? Die meiste Zeit am Nachmittag, weil ich am Anfang einen Fehler gemacht habe. Was hat die Regierung angekündigt? Einen neuen Plan zur Verbesserung der Straßen in ländlichen Gebieten. Was ist Ihre Lieblingsjahreszeit? Herbst, wenn die Blätter ihre Farbe wechseln. Hast du mit dem Zug oder dem Bus gefahren? Mit dem Zug, weil es schneller und bequemer ist. Wie oft trainiert das Team? Zweimal pro Woche, und mehr vor wichtigen Spielen. Was hast du auf der Wissenschaftsmesse gelernt? Wie Roboter Pakete sehr schnell sortieren können. Warum wurden alte Städte in der Nähe von Flüssen gebaut? Flüsse boten Wasser, Nahrung und Transport. Wie weit ist der See von hier entfernt? Ungefähr eine Stunde zu Fuß durch den Wald. Wird künstliche Intelligenz viele Arbeitsplätze ersetzen? Einige Arbeitsplätze werden sich ändern, und neue werden entstehen. Wie produzieren Solarzellen Strom? Sie wandeln Sonnenlicht direkt in elektrische Energie um. Dürfen wir während der Prüfung Notizen benutzen? Nein, und Handys müssen ausgeschaltet sein. Sollen wir die wichtigsten Punkte noch einmal durchgehen, bevor wir fertig sind? Gute Idee. Lasst uns sie nacheinander durchgehen. Warum ist das Internet heute so langsam? Der Sturm hat einige Kabel in der Gegend beschädigt. Wer hat das alte Schloss auf dem Hügel gebaut? Niemand weiß es genau, aber es ist sehr alt. Wo sollen wir uns vor der Prüfung treffen? Lasst uns vor der Bibliothek etwas früher treffen. Haben Sie ein Backup Ihrer Dateien erstellt?

items.text: Что вы хотите поесть сегодня вечером? Что-нибудь простое, может, суп и свежий хлеб. Почему вы делаете столько перерывов во время учебы? items.name: Chinese (Simplified, Mandarin)
items.text: 考试前我们应该在哪里见面？让我们在图书馆前面稍微早一点见面。航班为什么延误？早上很早有浓雾。你今天读完那章了吗？是的，我昨晚读了，但是第二部分比较难。孩子们今天下午在做什么？他们在学校前面堆了一个雪人。你在科学展览会上学到了什么？机器人如何能非常快速地分类包裹。你在花园里种过什么吗？在阳台上种了一些草和番茄。机场离市中心有多远？不太远，火车大约需要半小时。在大型团队中工作是否困难？有时，但明确的角色会更容易。你能推荐一本好书吗？我刚刚读完一本关于一家人搬到国外的小说。现在外面天气怎么样？很冷而且有风，所以请带上保暖外套。为什么今天网络这么慢？暴风雨损坏了该地区的一些电缆。你今晚要来学习小组吗？我想去，但我必须工作到很晚。你昨晚听音乐会了吗？非常喜欢。管弦乐队很棒。为什么古代城市会建在河流附近？河流提供了水、食物和交通。海中的潮汐是由什么引起的？主要原因是月球对水的引力。你想在公园里踢足球吗？也许之后，当不那么热的时候。你是坐火车还是坐公交车？火车，因为它更快更舒适。公共交通比开车便宜吗？通常是这样，而且对环境也有好处。政府发布了什么消息？一项改善农村道路的新计划。你每天喝多少水？不够，我应该多喝。你能帮我解决这个问题吗？当然。先给我看看错误信息。垃圾分类真的值得吗？是的，它减少了浪费，并节省了自然资源。考试期间是否允许使用笔记？不，并且手机必须关闭。今年谁负责这个项目？设计部门的经理。今晚你想吃什么？简单一点，也许是汤和新鲜的面包。为什么蜜蜂如此重要？它们是水果和蔬菜的授粉者。你的电脑现在又能用了吗？是的，更新解决了问题。球队多久进行一次训练？每周两次，以及在重要的比赛前。谁建造了那座位于山上的老城堡？没人确定，但它非常古老。我应该使用更强的密码吗？当然。使用一个容易记住的较长的短语。你今天早上看了新闻吗？只有标题。有什么重要的消息发布了吗？报告的截止日期是什么时候？周末结束前，在会议之前。医生给你什么建议了吗？她让我休息，多喝水。去海边旅行怎么样？非常好。我们每天晚上沿着海滩散步。作者会在书店发表演讲吗？
items.reference_en: Where should we meet before the exam? Let us meet in front of the library a little early. Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. Did you finish reading the chapter for today? Yes, I read it last night, but the second half was difficult. What are the children doing this afternoon? They are building a snowman in front of the school. What did you learn at the science fair? How robots can sort packages very quickly. Have you planted anything in the garden? Some herbs and tomatoes on the balcony. Is the airport far from the city center? Not really, the train takes about half an hour. Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. What is the weather like outside? It is cold and windy, so bring a warm jacket. Why is the internet so slow today? The storm damaged some of the cables in the area. Are you coming to the study group this evening? I would like to, but I have to work until late. Did you enjoy the concert last night? Very much. The orchestra was wonderful. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. What causes the tides in the ocean? Mainly the pull of the moon on the water. Do you want to play football in the park? Maybe later, when it is not so hot. Did you take the train or the bus? The train, because it is faster and more comfortable. Is public transport cheaper than driving? Usually, and it is better for the environment too. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. Can you help me with this program? Sure. Show me the error message first. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources. Are we allowed to use notes during the exam? No, and phones must be switched off. Who is leading the project this year? The manager from the design department. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Why are bees so important? They pollinate the plants that give us fruit and vegetables. Is your computer working again? Yes, the update fixed the problem. How often does the team practice? Twice a week, and more before important games. Who built the old castle on the hill? Nobody knows for sure, but it is very old. Should I use a stronger password? Definitely. Use a long phrase that is easy for you to remember. Did you read the news this morning? Only the headlines. Was something important announced? When is the report due? At the end of the week, before the meeting. Did the doctor give you any advice? She told me to rest and drink plenty of water. How was the trip to the coast? Beautiful. We walked along the beach every evening. Is the author giving a talk at the bookstore?

items.name: Cantonese (Traditional Chinese characters, spoken Cantonese)
items.text: 你搭咗火車定巴士？搭火車，因為佢係快啲同舒服啲。你喺花園種過嘢未？陽台上有啲草藥同番茄。今晚你想食咩？簡單啲，可能係湯同新鮮麵包。你可以再解釋下最後一個例子嗎？當然。我哋會將數據分開，然後比較結果。你擔心個演講嗎？唔多，但係我已經練習咗幾次。作者喺書店會講嘢嗎？係，喺星期四嘅晚上，而且佢會簽名。感謝你今日嘅幫忙。唔客氣。下星期見。邊個人教你做麵包？我嘅阿婆教我嘅，嗰時我まだ小朋友。政府宣布咗咩？改善農村道路嘅新方案。你覺得呢個早上的講座係咪好？好有意思，特別係關於訓練數據嘅部分。你鍾意咩音樂？主要係舒緩嘅音樂，有助我放鬆。你去咗新嘅畫廊？唔係，但係聽講畫作好正。博物館星期一閂唔開？唔係，星期一閂，但係其他日子都開。你以前試過學第二種語言？係，我每日用App練習。下次巴士幾時出？十分鐘，喺對面嘅巴士站。呢個星期尾會唔會下雨？預報話星期日會有細雨。點樣可以令工程師製造出慳能源嘅車？透過令佢哋更輕、更有效。你喺夏天去邊度玩？佢哋去咗附近山嘅一個靜靜嘅村。你早起身睇新聞咗未？只有標題。 有咩重要新聞？呢個節慶值得去睇嗎？絕對值得。人嚟自好多國家。你的電腦又可以正常運作？係，更新修復咗問題。蜜蜂係咁重要？佢哋為我哋提供果實同蔬菜嘅植物授粉。你可以幫我解決呢個程式問題嗎？當然。先睇吓錯誤訊息。唔好唔好喺結業前再複習一下？好諗，俾我哋逐個去。學習一門語言最困難嘅地方？能夠自信咁講嘢，尤其係電話。蔬菜嘅價錢點樣升嘅？夏季非常乾燥，所以收成唔好。我們可以將會議安排到下午嗎？啱啱好。 我會通知其他人。人工智能會取代好多工作嗎？有啲工作會改變，仲會出現新嘅。你儲咗檔案嘅備份？當然，我總係喺其他硬碟上儲。你每日飲幾多水？唔夠，我應該多飲啲。點解古代嘅城市會喺河邊？河水提供水、食物同運輸。今日你感覺好啲？好啲，多謝。 呢啲嘢真係有幫助。飛機係遲咗？早上早晨有厚霧。回收係值得唔值得？係，減少浪費，同埋儲備自然資源。太陽能板係點產生電力？佢哋將太陽光直接轉換成電力。你見到下星期嘅新時間表嗎？係，會議改咗去下午。今日下午小朋友哋做咩啊？佢哋喺學校嘅前面堆砌雪人。你會唔會搭自行車去工？唔好天氣，係。你最鍾意嘅季節係咩？仲秋，當落葉變色嗰陣。你係工作前定後做運動？通常係早晨，喺辦公室閂之前。報告嘅截止日期係？禮拜結束嘅時候，喺會前。最終考試會考咩？呢個學期嘅所有嘢。你今晚會嚟讀書會嗎？我想去，但係我得閒要工作到晚。你想買樓嗎？唔一定，但係現時租住比較容易。點解模型喺新數據上表現唔好？因為佢記住咗訓練例子，唔係學習模式。呢個錯誤訊息意思係咩？意思係檔案搵唔到。你鍾意讀書定睇電影？讀書，因為我可以自己想像故事。你嘅第一日喺新工作係點？忙碌，但係同事都好友善。你參加咗海灘清理活動？係，我哋收集咗好多垃圾袋。考試前喺邊度見面？俾我喺圖書館前面早啲見面。你喺科學展覽學到咩？點樣可以令機器快速分類包裹。喺結業前有咩問題？只有一個：下一次嘅課堂係幾時？你可以推薦附近好嘅餐廳？街邊嗰間小餐廳賣得好好嘅麵。
items.reference_en: Did you take the train or the bus? The train, because it is faster and more comfortable. Have you planted anything in the garden? Some herbs and tomatoes on the balcony. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Could you explain the last example again? Of course. We split the data and compare the results. Are you nervous about the presentation? A little, but I have practiced it several times. Is the author giving a talk at the bookstore? Yes, on Thursday evening, and she will sign copies. Thank you for your help today. You are welcome. See you next week. Who taught you how to bake bread? My grandmother taught me when I was a child. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. What did you think of the lecture this morning? It was interesting, especially the part about training data. What kind of music do you enjoy? Mostly calm music that helps me relax. Have you visited the new art gallery? Not yet, but I heard the paintings are impressive. Is the museum open on Mondays? No, it is closed on Mondays but open the rest of the week. Have you ever tried learning a second language? Yes, I practice a little every day with an app. When does the next bus leave? In ten minutes, from the stop across the street. Will it rain this weekend? The forecast says there will be light rain on Sunday. How can engineers make cars use less energy? By making them lighter and more efficient. Where did you go on your summer holiday? We visited a quiet village near the mountains. Did you read the news this morning? Only the headlines. Was something important announced? Is the festival worth visiting? Absolutely. People come from many countries. Is your computer working again? Yes, the update fixed the problem. Why are bees so important? They pollinate the plants that give us fruit and vegetables. Can you help me with this program? Sure. Show me the error message first. Shall we review the main points before we finish? Good idea. Let us go through them one by one. What is the hardest part of learning a language? Speaking with confidence, especially on the phone. Why did the price of vegetables go up? The summer was very dry, so the harvest was small. Can we move the meeting to the afternoon? That works for me. I will tell the others. Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs? Some jobs will change, and new ones will appear. Did you save a backup of your files? Of course, I always keep a copy on another drive. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. Are you feeling better today? Much better, thank you. The rest really helped. Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources. How do solar panels produce electricity? They turn sunlight directly into electrical energy. Have you seen the new schedule for next week? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. What are the children doing this afternoon? They are building a snowman in front of the school. Do you ride your bicycle to work? When the weather is good, yes. What is your favorite season? Autumn, when the leaves change color. Do you exercise before or after work? Usually in the morning, before the office opens. When is the report due? At the end of the week, before the meeting. What will the final exam cover? Everything we have studied this term. Are you coming to the study group this evening? I would like to, but I have to work until late. Would you like to buy a house one day? Maybe, but for now renting is easier. Why does the model perform badly on new data? Because it memorized the training examples instead of learning patterns. What does this error message mean? It means the file could not be found. Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Books, because I can imagine the story myself. How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. Where should we meet before the exam? Let us meet in front of the library a little early. What did you learn at the science fair? How robots can sort packages very quickly. Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby? The small place on the corner serves excellent noodles.

items.name: Japanese
items.text: どのようにしてお金を貯めていますか？毎週少しずつ貯めています。そのお祭りは訪れる価値がありますか？もちろん。多くの国から人々が来ます。どのようにして猫を迎えましたか？町の外にある動物保護施設から。あなたの仕事で最も好きなことは何ですか？良好なコミュニケーションをとるチームで働くこと。公園でサッカーをしたいですか？たぶん後で、暑すぎない時に。最後の例をもう一度説明してもらえますか？もちろんです。データを分割して結果を比較します。医者は何かアドバイスをしましたか？彼女は、休息してたくさん水を飲むように言いました。人工知能は多くの仕事を代替しますか？働き方は変わるでしょうし、新しい仕事も生まれます。大きなチームで働くことは難しいですか？時々ですが、明確な役割があれば容易になります。ファイルのバックアップを取っていますか？もちろん、常に別のドライブにコピーを保管しています。今日の午後に子供たちは何をしていますか？学校の前で雪だるまを作っています。庭に何か植えましたか？バルコニーにはハーブとトマトをいくつか。あなたの犬は散歩が好きですか？彼は特に川の近くで大好きです。ハイキングに何を持っていけばいいですか？水、食べ物、地図、暖かい服。海の清掃活動にボランティアしましたか？はい、たくさんのゴミ袋を集めました。リサイクルは本当に価値がありますか？はい、廃棄物を減らし、自然資源を節約します。あなたのチームは土曜日の試合で勝ったのですか？はい、最後の数分に勝ったのです。コンピューターはもう動いていますか？はい、アップデートで問題が解決しました。どんな音楽が好きですか？落ち着いた音楽が好きで、リラックスできます。言語を学ぶのが一番難しいことは何ですか？
items.reference_en: How do you manage to save money? I put aside a little every week. Is the festival worth visiting? Absolutely. People come from many countries. Where did you adopt your cat? From the animal shelter on the edge of town. What do you like most about your work? Working with a team that communicates well. Do you want to play football in the park? Maybe later, when it is not so hot. Could you explain the last example again? Of course. We split the data and compare the results. Did the doctor give you any advice? She told me to rest and drink plenty of water. Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs? Some jobs will change, and new ones will appear. Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. Did you save a backup of your files? Of course, I always keep a copy on another drive. What are the children doing this afternoon? They are building a snowman in front of the school. Have you planted anything in the garden? Some herbs and tomatoes on the balcony. Does your dog like going for walks? He loves it, especially near the river. What should we pack for the hike? Water, food, a map and a warm layer. Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources. Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes. Is your computer working again? Yes, the update fixed the problem. What kind of music do you enjoy? Mostly calm music that helps me relax. What is the hardest part of learning a language?

items.name: Korean
items.text: 여름 휴가 때 어디로 갔나요? 우리는 산 근처 조용한 마을을 방문했습니다. 교수님은 마감일을 엄격하게 지키나요? 매우 엄격하므로, 늦게 제출하지 마세요. 겨울에 산길이 열려 있나요? 아니요, 보통 눈 때문에 닫혀 있습니다. 언젠가 집을 사는 것을 원하시나요? 아마도, 하지만 지금은 임대하는 것이 더 쉬워요. 팀은 얼마나 자주 훈련하나요? 일주일에 두 번, 중요한 경기 전에 더 자주. 저는 그렇게 확신하지 못합니다. 당신의 강아지는 산책하는 것을 좋아하나요? 네, 특히 강가 근처에서는요. 비행이 지연된 이유는 무엇인가요? 아침 일찍 짙은 안개가 끼었습니다. 시장에서 과일을 사야 할까요? 네, 그곳의 과일은 마트에 있는 것보다 신선합니다. 책을 읽는 것을 선호하시나요, 아니면 영화를 보는 것을 선호하시나요? 책, 왜냐하면 저 스스로 이야기를 상상할 수 있기 때문입니다. 저도 그렇게 생각합니다. 이번 주말에 비가 올까요? 일요일에 가벼운 비가 올 것으로 예상됩니다. 매일 물을 얼마나 마시나요? 충분하지 않아요, 정말 더 마셔야 해요. 저는 그것을 기억할 것입니다. 어젯밤 콘서트가 즐거웠나요? 매우 즐거웠습니다. 오케스트라가 훌륭했습니다. 태양 전지가 어떻게 전기를 생산하나요? 태양 빛을 직접 전기 에너지로 변환합니다. 오늘 아침 강의에 대해 어떻게 생각하셨나요? 흥미로웠어요, 특히 훈련 데이터에 대한 부분이요. 그렇습니다. 공원에서 축구를 하고 싶으신가요? 아마도 나중에, 너무 덥지 않을 때. 왜 채소 가격이 올랐나요? 여름이 매우 건조해서 수확량이 적었어요. 돈을 모으는 방법이 궁금해요. 매주 조금씩 저축하고 있어요. 이 곳에서 호수까지 얼마나 떨어져 있나요? 숲을 걸어서 약 한 시간. 그렇습니다. 더 강력한 비밀번호를 사용해야 할까요? 물론입니다. 기억하기 쉬운 긴 문장을 사용하세요. 혹시 바다에서 고래를 본 적이 있나요? 한 번, 멀리 떨어진 바다에서 배를 타고. 오늘 아침 뉴스 보셨나요? 오직 헤드라인만. 중요한 내용이 발표되었나요? 흥미롭네요, 더 알려주세요. 마지막 예제를 다시 설명해 주시겠어요? 물론입니다. 데이터를 나누고 결과를 비교합니다. 과학 축제에서 무엇을 배웠나요? 로봇이 어떻게 매우 빠르게 패키지를 분류할 수 있는지. 기차를 탔나요, 버스를 탔나요? 기차, 왜냐하면 더 빠르고 편안하기 때문입니다. 제가 생각하는 바로 그거입니다. 어떤 종류의 음악을 즐겨 들으세요? 주로 저를 편안하게 해주는 잔잔한 음악. 저도 마찬가지입니다. 공부할 때 왜 그렇게 자주 휴식을 취하는 건가요? 짧은 휴식은 더 오래 집중하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 호텔에 방을 예약하셨나요? ប៉ុន្តែបើកដំណើរការក្នុងថ្ងៃផ្សេងៗនៃសប្តាហ៍។អ្នកចូលចិត្តប្រភេទសម្លណា?ជាទូទៅ, សម្លដែលជួយឲ្យខ្ញុំសម្រាក។រដ្ឋាភិបាលបានប្រកាសអ្វី?ផែនការថ្មីមួយដើម្បីអភិវឌ្ឍផ្លូវនៅតំបន់ជនបទ។ឥឡូវនេះកុមារកំពុងធ្វើអ្វី?ពួកគេកំពុងសាងរូបមនុស្សដីកកនៅខាងមុខសាលារៀន។វាករណីដែលអ្នកចូលចិត្ត?តុល្យ, នៅពេលដែលស្លឹកផ្លាស់ពណ៌។អ្នកយល់ឃើញពីការបង្ហាញនេះនៅព្រឹកនេះយ៉ាងដូចម្តេច?វាជាការគួរឱ្យចាប់អារម្មណ៍, ជាពិសេសផ្នែកអំពីតិន។តើអ្នកបានស្នាក់នៅសណ្ឋាគារទេ?ទេ, មួយបន្ទប់ដែលមានទស្សនៈលើលក។តើអ្នកអាចណែស៍កុបអញ្ចកល្អមួយបានទេ?ខ្ញុំបានបញ្ចប់កុបអញ្ចកមួយអំពីគ្រួសារមួយដែលបានចាកចេញទៅ។អាចជួយខ្ញុំជាមួយកម្មវិធីនេះបានទេ?បាន។ សូមបង្ហាញអត្ថបទលំហើញមុន។អាកាសធាតុនៅក្រៅជាយ៉ាងដូចម្តេចដែរ?វាមានអាកាសធាតុត្រជាក់ និងខ្យល់រញ្ជួយ, ដូច្នេះសូមយកអាវក្រមាដ៏ក្តៅមួយមកជាមួយ។អ្នកប្រាប់នៅសកលអញ្ចកទេ?ពិត, នៅថ្ងៃអង្គារយប់, ហើយគាត់នឹងសហរ។តម្លៃអាកាសយានដ្ឋានឆ្ងាយពីទីក្រុងទេ?មិនសោះ, ទស្សនា차យកពេលប្រហែល៣០នាទី។វិស្វករអាចធ្វើអោយរថយន្តប្រើថាមពលតិរាបបានយ៉ាងដូចម្តេច?ដោយធ្វើឱ្យពួកវាមានទម្ងន់ស្រាល និងមានប្រសិទ្ធភាពជាងមុន។តើបច្ចេកវិជ្ជានិងកុំព្យូទ័រនឹងជំនួបការងារច្រើនទេ?មួយចំនួននៃការងារនឹងផ្លាស់ប្តូរ, ហើយការងារថ្មីៗនឹងមក។តើអ្នកបើកបរម៉ូតូទៅការងារដែរទេ?នៅពេលដែលស 날ល្អ, គឺពិត។អត្ថបទលំហើញនេះមានន័យអ្វី?វាមានន័យថា ទម្រង់មិនអាចរកឃើញ។ហេតុអ្វីម៉ូដែលមិនអាចធ្វើបាននៅលើតិនថ្មី?ព្រោះវាបានចងចាំនូវឧត្តរដែលបានប្រើប្រាស់ មិនបានរៀនលំដាប់.អ្នកបានទៅមើលវិហារថ្មីដែរឬទេ?ទេ, ប៉ុន្តែខ្ញុំឮថា ឆ្នូតគឺអស្ចារ្យ។តើអ្នកមកចូលរួមក្រុមសិក្សានៅយប់នេះទេ?ខ្ញុំចង់, ប៉ុន្តែខ្ញុំត្រូវធ្វើការរហូតដល់យប់.ហេតុអ្វីបានជាអ៊ីនធឺណិតមានល្បឿនយឺតខ្លាំងណាស់ថ្ងៃនេះ?ខ្សែបានខូច ដោយព្យបោះ។អ្នកផឹកទឹកប៉ុន្មានថ្ងៃ?មិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ទេ, ខ្ញុំគួរតែផឹកឲ្យបានច្រើនជាងនេះ។ហេតុអ្វីបានជាទីក្រុងបុរាណត្រូវបានសាងសង់នៅជិតសមុទ្រ?
