Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes. Could you explain the last example again? Of course. We split the data and compare the results. What did you learn at the science fair? How robots can sort packages very quickly. How do you remember what you read? I write a short summary after each chapter. Have you ever tried learning a second language? Yes, I practice a little every day with an app. How long did the homework take you? Most of the afternoon, because I made a mistake at the start. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources. Is the professor strict about deadlines? Very strict, so please do not submit anything late. Is the museum open on Mondays? No, it is closed on Mondays but open the rest of the week. What kind of music do you enjoy? Mostly calm music that helps me relax. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. What are the children doing this afternoon? They are building a snowman in front of the school. What is your favorite season? Autumn, when the leaves change color. What did you think of the lecture this morning? It was interesting, especially the part about training data. Did you book a room at the hotel? Yes, a room with a view of the lake. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. Can you help me with this program? Sure. Show me the error message first. What is the weather like outside? It is cold and windy, so bring a warm jacket. Is the author giving a talk at the bookstore? Yes, on Thursday evening, and she will sign copies. Is the airport far from the city center? Not really, the train takes about half an hour. How can engineers make cars use less energy? By making them lighter and more efficient. Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs? Some jobs will change, and new ones will appear. Do you ride your bicycle to work? When the weather is good, yes. What does this error message mean? It means the file could not be found. Why does the model perform badly on new data? Because it memorized the training examples instead of learning patterns. Have you visited the new art gallery? Not yet, but I heard the paintings are impressive. Are you coming to the study group this evening? I would like to, but I have to work until late. Why is the internet so slow today? The storm damaged some of the cables in the area. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. Why were ancient cities built near rivers?

items.name: Burmese
items.text: မော်ဒယ်သည် ဘာကြောင့် အသစ်သော ဒေတာပေါ်တွင် အဆင်မပြေဖြစ်ရသလဲ။သင်ယူထားသော ဥပဒေ့များကိုသာ မှတ်ယူထားခြင်းကြောင့်၊ ပုံစံများကို သင်ယူခြင်းမရှိသောကြောင့် ဖြစ်သည်။ဒီနေ့ညမှာ ဘာစားချင်လဲ။အဆန်အသင့်စားရမယ့် အစားအစာမျိုးပေါ့၊ အထုပ်ကြော်နဲ့ အသစ်ထောင်းထားတဲ့ ခမီးရောင်ပေါင်မုန့်မျိုးပေါ့။စစ်ဆေးမှုမေးပွဲမတိုင်မီ ဘယ်နေရာတွင် တွေ့ဆုံသင့်မည်။ကောင်တာတစ်ခုတွင် အနည်းငယ်စော၍ တွေ့ဆုံကြရအောင်။နောက်ပတ်အတွက် အစီအစဉ်သစ်ကို မြင်တွေ့ခဲ့ပြီလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ အစည်းအဝေးကို ညနေပိုင်းသို့ ပြောင်းလဲခဲ့သည်။မော်ပြတိုက်ကို တနင်္ကူးနေ့မှာလည်း ဖွင့်ထားပါသလား။မဟုတ်ပါဘူး၊ တနင်္ကူးနေ့မှာ ပိတ်ထားပြီး ကျန်တဲ့ ရက်တွေမှာတော့ ဖွင့်ထားပါတယ်။ယနေ့ ကျွန်ုပ်အား ကူညီပေးမှုအတွက် ကျေးဇူးတင်ပါသည်။ဧည့်ခံပါသည်။ နောက်ပတ်တွင် တွေ့ကြပါမည်။နောက်ဆုံးဥပမာကို နောက်တစ်ကြိမ်ရှင်းပြနိုင်ပါသလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့။ ကျွန်ုပ်တို့သည် ဒေတာကို ခွဲခြားပြီး အထွက်လေ့ကို တူညီအောင် လုပ်သည်။စာရေးဆရာက စာအုပ်ဆိုင်မှာ ဟောပြောပွဲ လုပ်ပေးပါသလား။ဟုတ်ပါတယ်။ ညနေပိုင်း ပဉ္စမရက်မှာ လုပ်ပေးမှာဖြစ်ပြီး သူက စာအုပ်တွေကို လက်မှတ်ရေးပေးမှာပါ။ဒုတိယ ဘာသာစကား သင်ယူဖူးပါသလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ ကျွန်တော်က နေ့တိုင်း တစ်နေ့နည်းနည်းကို အက်ပ်တစ်ခုနဲ့ လေ့ကျင့်ပါတယ်။ဒီနှစ်အတွက် ပရောဂျက်ကို ဘယ်သူက ဦးဆောင်နေလဲ။ဒီဇိုင်းဌာနမှ မန်နေဂျာတစ်ဦးပါ။သင်က အလုပ်သွားချိန်မှာ ဘီးစီးပြီး သွားလေ့ရှိလား။မျှန်တုန်ကောင်းတဲ့အခါမျိုးမှာ သွားတတ်ပါတယ်။ကျွန်ုပ်တို့ ပြီးဆုံးရန် မတိုင်မီ သင်၌ မေးခွန်းများ ရှိပါသလား။တစ်ခုသာရှိပါသည် - နောက်ထပ် အစည်းအဝေးက ဘယ်အချိန်ကျရောက်မည်သလဲ။မနေ့က သင်က နေဝင်ချိန်ကို မြင်ခဲ့ပါသလား။ဟုတ်ပါတယ်။ နေရာတစ်လျှောက်လုံးမှာ အညိုရောင်နဲ့ ပန်းရောင်တွေ ဖြစ်နေပါတယ်။နောက်ထပ် ဘတ်စ်ကားက ဘယ်အချိန် ထွက်သွားမှာလဲ။ဆယ် မိနစ်လောက်ကြာမှာပဲ၊ တဲလမ်းဘက်မှာရှိတဲ့ ဘတ်စ်ကားရပ်ကွက်ကနေ ထွက်သွားမှာပါ။ညနေခင်းမှာ သို့မဟုတ် ညနေခင်းအလုပ်ပြီးတဲ့နောက်မှာ အားကစား လုပ်လေ့ရှိလား။
items.reference_en: Why does the model perform badly on new data? Because it memorized the training examples instead of learning patterns. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Where should we meet before the exam? Let us meet in front of the library a little early. Have you seen the new schedule for next week? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. Is the museum open on Mondays? No, it is closed on Mondays but open the rest of the week. Thank you for your help today. You are welcome. See you next week. Could you explain the last example again? Of course. We split the data and compare the results. Is the author giving a talk at the bookstore? Yes, on Thursday evening, and she will sign copies. Have you ever tried learning a second language? Yes, I practice a little every day with an app. Who is leading the project this year? The manager from the design department. Do you ride your bicycle to work? When the weather is good, yes. Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? Did you see the sunset yesterday? Yes, the whole sky turned orange and pink. When does the next bus leave? In ten minutes, from the stop across the street. Do you exercise before or after work?

items.name: Hindi
items.text: अंतिम परीक्षा में क्या शामिल होगा? हमने इस सेमेस्टर में जो कुछ भी पढ़ा है। क्या आप आज शाम अध्ययन समूह में आ रहे हैं? मैं आना चाहता हूँ, लेकिन मुझे देर तक काम करना है। आप आज रात क्या खाना चाहेंगे? कुछ सरल, शायद सूप और ताजी ब्रेड। किसने आपको ब्रेड बनाने के बारे में सिखाया? मेरी दादी ने मुझे बचपन में सिखाया था। क्या सार्वजनिक परिवहन, ड्राइविंग से सस्ता है? आमतौर पर, और यह पर्यावरण के लिए भी बेहतर है। क्या आपको कल रात का कॉन्सर्ट पसंद आया? बहुत। ऑर्केस्ट्रा अद्भुत था। आपको अपने काम के बारे में सबसे अच्छा क्या पसंद है? एक ऐसे टीम के साथ काम करना जो अच्छी तरह से संवाद करता है। क्या आपने बगीचे में कुछ लगाया है? बालकनी पर कुछ जड़ी-बूटियाँ और टमाटर। आपका पसंदीदा मौसम कौन सा है? शरद ऋतु, जब पत्ते रंग बदलते हैं। क्या आप आज बेहतर महसूस कर रहे हैं? बहुत बेहतर, धन्यवाद। बाकी चीजें वास्तव में मदद मिलीं। क्या आपने आज के अध्याय को पढ़ने का काम पूरा कर लिया? हाँ, मैंने कल रात पढ़ा, लेकिन दूसरा भाग कठिन था। उड़ान क्यों देरी हुई? सुबह जल्दी घना कोहरा था। क्या प्रोफेसर समय सीमा के बारे में सख्त हैं? बहुत सख्त, इसलिए कृपया देर से कुछ भी जमा न करें। क्या आपने आज सुबह समाचार पढ़ा? केवल शीर्षक। क्या कोई महत्वपूर्ण घोषणा हुई? आपने अपना बिल्ली कहाँ अपनाया? शहर के किनारे स्थित एक पशु आश्रय से। टीम कितनी बार अभ्यास करती है? प्रति सप्ताह दो बार, और महत्वपूर्ण खेलों से पहले। परीक्षा से पहले हमें कहाँ मिलना चाहिए? आइए थोड़ा जल्दी पुस्तकालय के सामने मिलें। क्या मुझे एक मजबूत पासवर्ड का उपयोग करना चाहिए? निश्चित रूप से। एक लंबा वाक्यांश का उपयोग करें जिसे याद रखना आपके लिए आसान हो। क्या इस सप्ताहांत में बारिश होगी? पूर्वानुमान में बताया गया है कि रविवार को हल्की बारिश होगी। मधुमक्खियां इतनी महत्वपूर्ण क्यों हैं? वे पौधे को परागित करते हैं जो हमें फल और सब्जियां देते हैं। आज आपकी मदद के लिए धन्यवाद। आपका स्वागत है। अगले सप्ताह मिलते हैं। क्या परीक्षा के दौरान नोट्स का उपयोग करने की अनुमति है? नहीं, और फोन बंद करने चाहिए। आपने अपने गर्मी की छुट्टी में कहाँ गए थे? हमने पहाड़ों के पास एक शांत गाँव में यात्रा की। क्या आप आस-पास कोई अच्छी रेस्तरां सुझा सकते हैं? कोने पर स्थित छोटा ढाबे में उत्कृष्ट नूडल्स मिलते हैं। सरकार ने क्या घोषणा की? ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में सड़कों को बेहतर बनाने की एक नई योजना। आपने कल रात कैसे सोया? बुरा। पड़ोसी जोर-जोर से संगीत बजा रहे थे। आपके नए नौकरी के पहले दिन का अनुभव कैसा रहा? व्यस्त, लेकिन मेरे सहकर्मी बहुत मिलनसार थे। आप पैसे कैसे बचाते हैं? मैं हर हफ्ते थोड़ा सा अलग रख लेता हूँ। समुद्र में ज्वार क्यों आते हैं? मुख्य रूप से पानी पर चंद्रमा का गुरुत्वाकर्षण। प्राचीन शहरों को नदियों के पास क्यों बनाया गया? नदियाँ पानी, भोजन और परिवहन प्रदान करती हैं। सब्जियों की कीमत क्यों बढ़ी? गर्मी बहुत शुष्क थी, इसलिए फसल कम हुई। क्या लेखक पुस्तक की दुकान पर भाषण दे रहे हैं? हाँ, गुरुवार की शाम, और वे प्रतियां हस्ताक्षरित करेंगे। क्या कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता कई नौकरियों को बदल देगी? कुछ नौकरियां बदल जाएंगी, और नई नौकरियां भी पैदा होंगी। क्या आपको क्रॉस वैलिडेशन कैसे काम करता है, यह समझ में आता है?
items.reference_en: What will the final exam cover? Everything we have studied this term. Are you coming to the study group this evening? I would like to, but I have to work until late. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Who taught you how to bake bread? My grandmother taught me when I was a child. Is public transport cheaper than driving? Usually, and it is better for the environment too. Did you enjoy the concert last night? Very much. The orchestra was wonderful. What do you like most about your work? Working with a team that communicates well. Have you planted anything in the garden? Some herbs and tomatoes on the balcony. What is your favorite season? Autumn, when the leaves change color. Are you feeling better today? Much better, thank you. The rest really helped. Did you finish reading the chapter for today? Yes, I read it last night, but the second half was difficult. Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. Is the professor strict about deadlines? Very strict, so please do not submit anything late. Did you read the news this morning? Only the headlines. Was something important announced? Where did you adopt your cat? From the animal shelter on the edge of town. How often does the team practice? Twice a week, and more before important games. Where should we meet before the exam? Let us meet in front of the library a little early. Should I use a stronger password? Definitely. Use a long phrase that is easy for you to remember. Will it rain this weekend? The forecast says there will be light rain on Sunday. Why are bees so important? They pollinate the plants that give us fruit and vegetables. Thank you for your help today. You are welcome. See you next week. Are we allowed to use notes during the exam? No, and phones must be switched off. Where did you go on your summer holiday? We visited a quiet village near the mountains. Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby? The small place on the corner serves excellent noodles. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. How did you sleep last night? Badly. The neighbors were playing loud music. How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. How do you manage to save money? I put aside a little every week. What causes the tides in the ocean? Mainly the pull of the moon on the water. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. Why did the price of vegetables go up? The summer was very dry, so the harvest was small. Is the author giving a talk at the bookstore? Yes, on Thursday evening, and she will sign copies. Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs? Some jobs will change, and new ones will appear. Do you understand how cross validation works?

items.name: Bengali
items.text: আপনি কি আজ সন্ধ্যায় স্টাডি গ্রুপের সাথে যোগ দেবেন? আমি যেতে চাই, কিন্তু আমাকে晚 পর্যন্ত কাজ করতে হবে। আপনার হোমওয়ার্ক করতে কত সময় লেগেছে? বেশিরভাগ সময়, কারণ আমি শুরুতে ভুল করেছি। আপনি কি আশেপাশে কোনো ভালো রেস্তোরাঁ সুপারিশ করতে পারেন? কোণের ধারে অবস্থিত ছোট দোকানটিতে খুব সুস্বাদু নুডলস পাওয়া যায়। আপনি আপনার বিড়ালকে কোথা থেকে সংগ্রহ করেছেন? শহরের প্রান্তে অবস্থিত পশু আশ্রয়কেন্দ্র থেকে। আপনার দল কতবার অনুশীলন করে? সপ্তাহে দুইবার, এবং গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ম্যাচের আগে আরও। বিমানবন্দরটি কি শহরের কেন্দ্র থেকে দূরে? না, ট্রেন প্রায় আধা ঘণ্টার সময় লাগে। পরীক্ষার সময় নোট ব্যবহার করার অনুমতি আছে কি? না, এবং ফোন বন্ধ রাখতে হবে। আপনি কি আপনার ফাইলের ব্যাকআপ রেখেছেন? অবশ্যই, আমি সবসময় অন্য ড্রাইভের একটি কপি রাখি। আপনি কি সময়সীমা সম্পর্কে কঠোর? খুবই কঠোর, তাই অনুগ্রহ করে কোনো কিছু দেরিতে জমা দেবেন না। প্রাচীন শহরগুলো কেন নদীর কাছাকাছি তৈরি করা হয়েছিল? নদী জল, খাদ্য এবং পরিবহন সরবরাহ করত। পরবর্তী বাস কখন ছাড়বে? দশ মিনিটের মধ্যে, রাস্তার অন্য প্রান্ত থেকে। আপনি কি আজকের অধ্যায়টি পড়েছেন? হ্যাঁ, আমি গতকাল রাতে পড়েছি, তবে দ্বিতীয় অংশটি কঠিন ছিল। আপনি আজ রাতে কি খেতে চান? কিছু সাধারণ, সম্ভবত স্যুপ এবং তাজা রুটি। এখানে থেকে হ্রদটি কত দূরে? প্রায় এক ঘণ্টা, জঙ্গলের মধ্যে হেঁটে। শীতকালে পাহাড়ি রাস্তা খোলা আছে? না, সাধারণত বরফের কারণে বন্ধ থাকে। পাহাড়ের উপরে পুরনো দুর্গটি কে তৈরি করেছিলেন? কেউ জানে না, তবে এটি খুবই পুরনো। আপনি আপনার কাজের কোন দিকটি সবচেয়ে বেশি পছন্দ করেন? একটি দলের সাথে কাজ করা, যারা ভালোভাবে যোগাযোগ করে। কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা কি অনেক কাজ প্রতিস্থাপন করবে? কিছু কাজ পরিবর্তিত হবে, এবং নতুন কাজ তৈরি হবে। আপনি কি ট্রেন বা বাসে গিয়েছিলেন? ট্রেন, কারণ এটি দ্রুত এবং আরামদায়ক। আপনি কি কোনো ভালো বইয়ের নাম সুপারিশ করতে পারেন? আমি সম্প্রতি একটি উপন্যাস শেষ করেছি, যেখানে একটি পরিবার বিদেশে চলে গেছে। আপনার নতুন কাজের প্রথম দিন কেমন ছিল? ব্যস্ত, তবে আমার সহকর্মীরা খুবই বন্ধুত্বপূর্ণ। আপনি কি পার্কের মধ্যে ফুটবল খেলতে চান? সম্ভবত পরে, যখন খুব গরম নয়। প্রকৌশলীরা কীভাবে গাড়িগুলোকে কম শক্তি ব্যবহার করতে উৎসাহিত করতে পারেন? সেগুলোকে হালকা এবং আরও দক্ষ করে। আপনি কি আগামী সপ্তাহের নতুন সময়সূচী দেখেছেন? হ্যাঁ, মিটিংটি বিকেলে স্থানান্তরিত করা হয়েছে। আপনি কি সমুদ্রের পরিচ্ছন্নতা অভিযানে অংশ নিয়েছিলেন? হ্যাঁ, আমরা অনেক আবর্জনা সংগ্রহ করেছি। বাইরে আবহাওয়া কেমন? এটি ঠান্ডা এবং বাতাসপূর্ণ, তাই একটি গরম জ্যাকেট নিয়ে যান। চূড়ান্ত পরীক্ষা কোন বিষয়গুলো কভার করবে? আমরা এই সেমিস্টারে যা শিখেছি। আপনার কম্পিউটার কি আবার কাজ করছে? হ্যাঁ, আপডেটটি সমস্যাটি সমাধান করেছে। আজকের জন্য আপনার সহায়তার জন্য ধন্যবাদ। আপনাকেও ধন্যবাদ। আগামী সপ্তাহে দেখা হবে। আপনি কি কাজ করার আগে বা পরে ব্যায়াম করেন? সাধারণত সকালে, অফিসের খোলার আগে। সৌর প্যানেল কীভাবে বিদ্যুৎ উৎপাদন করে? তারা সরাসরি সূর্যের আলোকে বিদ্যুতে রূপান্তরিত করে। আপনি কোন ধরনের গান পছন্দ করেন? মূলত এমন শান্ত গান যা আমাকে শান্ত হতে সাহায্য করে। সমুদ্র সৈকতে ভ্রমণ কেমন ছিল? সুন্দর। আমরা প্রতিদিন সন্ধ্যায় সমুদ্রের ধারে হেঁটেছি। আমরা কি হাইকিং-এর জন্য কিছু জিনিস নিতে পারি? জল, খাবার, একটি ম্যাপ এবং একটি উষ্ণ পোশাক। একটি বড় দলের সাথে কাজ করা কি কঠিন? মাঝে মাঝে, তবে স্পষ্ট ভূমিকা এটিকে সহজ করে তোলে। আপনি কি হোটেলে একটি ঘর বুক করেছেন? হ্যাঁ, হ্রদের দৃশ্য সহ একটি ঘর। ভালো যোগাযোগ কেন এত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ? কারণ ভুল বোঝাবুঝি একটি প্রকল্পের ক্ষতি করতে পারে। আপনার দল কি শনিবারে ম্যাচ জিতেছে? হ্যাঁ, আমরা শেষ কয়েক মিনিটে জিতেছি। ফ্লাইট কেন বিলম্বিত হয়েছিল? সকালে কুয়াশা ছিল। আপনি আজ সকালে লেকচারটি কেমন লাগলেন? এটি আকর্ষণীয় ছিল, বিশেষ করে প্রশিক্ষণ ডেটার অংশটি। আপনার প্রিয় ঋতু কোনটি? শরৎ, যখন পাতা রং বদলায়। আপনি কি ক্রস ভ্যালিডেশন কিভাবে কাজ করে তা বুঝতে পারেন?
items.reference_en: Are you coming to the study group this evening? I would like to, but I have to work until late. How long did the homework take you? Most of the afternoon, because I made a mistake at the start. Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby? The small place on the corner serves excellent noodles. Where did you adopt your cat? From the animal shelter on the edge of town. How often does the team practice? Twice a week, and more before important games. Is the airport far from the city center? Not really, the train takes about half an hour. Are we allowed to use notes during the exam? No, and phones must be switched off. Did you save a backup of your files? Of course, I always keep a copy on another drive. Is the professor strict about deadlines? Very strict, so please do not submit anything late. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. When does the next bus leave? In ten minutes, from the stop across the street. Did you finish reading the chapter for today? Yes, I read it last night, but the second half was difficult. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. How far is the lake from here? About an hour on foot through the forest. Are the mountain roads open in winter? No, they are usually closed because of the snow. Who built the old castle on the hill? Nobody knows for sure, but it is very old. What do you like most about your work? Working with a team that communicates well. Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs? Some jobs will change, and new ones will appear. Did you take the train or the bus? The train, because it is faster and more comfortable. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. Do you want to play football in the park? Maybe later, when it is not so hot. How can engineers make cars use less energy? By making them lighter and more efficient. Have you seen the new schedule for next week? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. What is the weather like outside? It is cold and windy, so bring a warm jacket. What will the final exam cover? Everything we have studied this term. Is your computer working again? Yes, the update fixed the problem. Thank you for your help today. You are welcome. See you next week. Do you exercise before or after work? Usually in the morning, before the office opens. How do solar panels produce electricity? They turn sunlight directly into electrical energy. What kind of music do you enjoy? Mostly calm music that helps me relax. How was the trip to the coast? Beautiful. We walked along the beach every evening. What should we pack for the hike? Water, food, a map and a warm layer. Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. Did you book a room at the hotel? Yes, a room with a view of the lake. Why is good communication so important? Because misunderstandings can ruin a project. Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes. Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. What did you think of the lecture this morning? It was interesting, especially the part about training data. What is your favorite season? Autumn, when the leaves change color. Do you understand how cross validation works?

items.text: தேர்வின்போது குறிப்புகளைப் பயன்படுத்த அனுமதிக்கப்படுமா? இல்லை, மேலும் தொலைபேசிகளை அணைக்க வேண்டும். அருகிலுள்ள ஒரு நல்ல உணவகத்தை பரிந்துரைக்க முடியுமா? மூலையில் உள்ள சிறிய இடம் சிறந்த நூடுல்ஸ் வழங்குகிறது. இந்த வார இறுதியில் மழை பெய்யுமா? ஞாயிற்றுக்கிழமை லேசான மழை பெய்யும் என்று முன்னறிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. விமான நிலையம் நகர மையத்திலிருந்து எவ்வளவு தூரத்தில் உள்ளது? இல்லை, ரயில் சுமார் அரை மணி நேரம் ஆகும். இந்த இடத்திலிருந்து ஏரி எவ்வளவு தூரத்தில் உள்ளது? காட்டின் வழியாக சுமார் ஒரு மணி நேரம் நடந்து. பொதுப் போக்குவரத்து ஓட்டுவதை விட மலிவானதா? பொதுவாக, அது சுற்றுச்சூழலுக்கும் நல்லது. உங்களுக்கு எந்த வகையான இசை பிடிக்கும்? அமைதியான இசை, இது எனக்கு ஓய்வெடுக்க உதவுகிறது. நீங்கள் கடற்கரை சுத்தம் செய்யும் பணியில் தன்னார்வத் தொண்டராக இருந்தீர்களா? ஆமாம், நாங்கள் நிறைய குப்பை சேகரித்தோம். வெளியே வானிலை எப்படி இருக்கிறது? அது குளிர் மற்றும் பலத்த காற்று, எனவே ஒரு சூடான ஜாக்கெட்டை எடுத்துச் செல்லுங்கள். ஒரு பெரிய குழுவில் வேலை செய்வது கடினமாக உள்ளதா? சில நேரங்களில், ஆனால் தெளிவான பங்குகள் அதை எளிதாக்குகின்றன. புதிய தரவுகளில் மாதிரி மோசமாக செயல்படுவதற்கான காரணம் என்ன? பயிற்சி எடுத்துக்காட்டுகளை கற்றுக்கொள்வதற்கு பதிலாக, அவை நினைவில் வைத்திருப்பதால். இன்று காலை நீங்கள் கருத்தரங்கத்தை பற்றி என்ன நினைக்கிறீர்கள்? அது சுவாரஸ்யமாக இருந்தது, குறிப்பாக பயிற்சி தரவு பற்றிய பகுதி. இந்த நிரலுக்கு நான் உங்களுக்கு உதவ முடியுமா? நிச்சயமாக. முதலில் பிழை செய்தியைக் காட்டுங்கள். கூட்டத்தை மதியத்திற்கு மாற்ற முடியுமா? அது எனக்குச் சரியானது. நான் மற்றவர்களுக்குச் சொல்வேன். கடலில் அலைகள் எதனால் ஏற்படுகின்றன? முக்கியமாக, நீர் மீது நிலவின் ஈர்ப்பு. நீங்கள் புதிய கலைக்கூட்டத்திற்கு சென்றீர்களா? இல்லை, ஆனால் ஓவியங்கள் அற்புதமானவை என்று கேள்விப்பட்டேன். இன்று இரவு நீங்கள் என்ன சாப்பிட விரும்புகிறீர்கள்? எளிய ஒன்று, ஒருவேளை சூப் மற்றும் புதிய ரொட்டி. இந்த வருடம் திட்டத்தை யார் வழிநடத்துகிறார்கள்? வடிவமைப்புத் துறையின் மேலாளர். வீட்டுப்பாடம் முடிக்க எவ்வளவு நேரம் ஆனது? பெரும்பாலான மதிய நேரம், ஏனென்றால் நான் ஆரம்பத்தில் ஒரு தவறு செய்தேன். உங்கள் புதிய வேலையில் முதல் நாள் எப்படி இருந்தது? பரபரப்பாக இருந்தது, ஆனால் எனது சக ஊழியர்கள் மிகவும் நட்பாக இருந்தார்கள். நீங்கள் பூங்காவில் கால்பந்து விளையாட விரும்புகிறீர்களா? ஒருவேளை, அது மிகவும் சூடாக இல்லாதபோது. நீங்கள் ரயில் அல்லது பேருந்தில் சென்றீர்களா? ரயில், ஏனெனில் அது வேகமானது மற்றும் வசதியானது. நீங்கள் உங்கள் கோடை விடுமுறையில் எங்கு சென்றீர்கள்? நாங்கள் மலைகளுக்கு அருகில் உள்ள ஒரு அமைதியான கிராமத்திற்கு சென்றோம். பொறியாளர்கள் கார்களை குறைந்த ஆற்றலைப் பயன்படுத்தும்படி செய்ய முடியுமா? அவற்றை இலகுவாகவும், திறமையாகவும் மாற்றுவதன் மூலம். நாம் முடிப்பதற்கு முன் முக்கிய புள்ளிகளை மதிப்பாய்வு செய்யலாமா? நல்ல யோசனை. ஒவ்வொன்றாக அவற்றை ஆராய்வோம். ஏன் பண்டைய நகரங்கள் நதிகளுக்கு அருகில் கட்டப்பட்டன? ஆறுகள் தண்ணீர், உணவு மற்றும் போக்குவரத்தை வழங்கின. நீங்கள் உங்கள் கோப்புகளின் காப்புப் பிரதியை சேமித்தீர்களா? நிச்சயமாக, நான் எப்போதும் மற்றொரு டிரைவில் ஒரு நகலை வைத்திருக்கிறேன். நீங்கள் ஒரு நல்ல புத்தகத்தை பரிந்துரைக்க முடியுமா? நான் வெளிநாட்டில் குடிபெயரும் ஒரு குடும்பத்தைப் பற்றிய ஒரு நாவலை சமீபத்தில் முடித்தேன். நீங்கள் நேற்று சூரிய அஸ்தமனத்தைப் பார்த்தீர்களா? ஆம், முழு வானமும் ஆரஞ்சு மற்றும் இளஞ்சிவப்பு நிறமாக மாறியது. மருத்துவர் உங்களுக்கு ஏதாவது ஆலோசனை வழங்கினாரா? அவர் எனக்கு ஓய்வெடுக்கவும் நிறைய தண்ணீர் குடிக்கவும் சொன்னார். மறுசுழற்சி உண்மையில் முயற்சியின் மதிப்புள்ளதா? ஆம், இது கழிவுகளைக் குறைக்கிறது மற்றும் இயற்கை வளங்களைப் பாதுகாக்கிறது. கடற்கரைக்கு பயணம் எப்படி இருந்தது? அழகாக இருந்தது. நாங்கள் ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் கடற்கரையில் நடந்து சென்றோம். இறுதித் தேர்வு எதை உள்ளடக்கும்? இந்த பருவத்தில் நாம் படித்த அனைத்தையும். உங்கள் அணி சனிக்கிழமை போட்டியில் வென்றதா? ஆம், நாங்கள் கடைசி சில நிமிடங்களில் வெ WON. அரசாங்கம் என்ன அறிவித்தது? கிராமப்புறங்களில் சாலைகளை மேம்படுத்தும் ஒரு புதிய திட்டம். உங்கள் கணினி மீண்டும் வேலை செய்கிறதா? ஆமாம், புதுப்பிப்பு சிக்கலை சரிசெய்தது. இன்று உங்கள் உதவிக்கு நன்றி. நன்றி. அடுத்த வாரம் உங்களை சந்திக்கிறேன். செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு பல வேலைகளை மாற்றியமைக்குமா? சில வேலைகள் மாறும், மேலும் புதிய வேலைகள் உருவாகும்.
items.reference_en: Are we allowed to use notes during the exam? No, and phones must be switched off. Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby? The small place on the corner serves excellent noodles. Will it rain this weekend? The forecast says there will be light rain on Sunday. Is the airport far from the city center? Not really, the train takes about half an hour. How far is the lake from here? About an hour on foot through the forest. Is public transport cheaper than driving? Usually, and it is better for the environment too. What kind of music do you enjoy? Mostly calm music that helps me relax. Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. What is the weather like outside? It is cold and windy, so bring a warm jacket. Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. Why does the model perform badly on new data? Because it memorized the training examples instead of learning patterns. What did you think of the lecture this morning? It was interesting, especially the part about training data. Can you help me with this program? Sure. Show me the error message first. Can we move the meeting to the afternoon? That works for me. I will tell the others. What causes the tides in the ocean? Mainly the pull of the moon on the water. Have you visited the new art gallery? Not yet, but I heard the paintings are impressive. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Who is leading the project this year? The manager from the design department. How long did the homework take you? Most of the afternoon, because I made a mistake at the start. How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. Do you want to play football in the park? Maybe later, when it is not so hot. Did you take the train or the bus? The train, because it is faster and more comfortable. Where did you go on your summer holiday? We visited a quiet village near the mountains. How can engineers make cars use less energy? By making them lighter and more efficient. Shall we review the main points before we finish? Good idea. Let us go through them one by one. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. Did you save a backup of your files? Of course, I always keep a copy on another drive. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. Did you see the sunset yesterday? Yes, the whole sky turned orange and pink. Did the doctor give you any advice? She told me to rest and drink plenty of water. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources. How was the trip to the coast? Beautiful. We walked along the beach every evening. What will the final exam cover? Everything we have studied this term. Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. Is your computer working again? Yes, the update fixed the problem. Thank you for your help today. You are welcome. See you next week. Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs? Some jobs will change, and new ones will appear.

items.name: Telugu
items.text: మీరు డబ్బును ఎలా ఆదా చేస్తారు? నేను ప్రతి వారం కొంచెం డబ్బును పక్కన పెడతాను. ఇది అర్థవంతంగా ఉంది. రచయిత పుస్తక దుకాణంలో ప్రసంగం చేస్తున్నారా? అవును, గురువారం సాయంత్రం, మరియు ఆమె కాపీలను సంతకం చేస్తారు. కృత్రిమ మేధస్సు అనేక ఉద్యోగాలను భర్తీ చేస్తుందా? కొన్ని ఉద్యోగాలు మారతాయి, మరియు కొత్తవి కూడా వస్తాయి. నాకు కూడా అదే అనుభవం ఉంది. ఈ ఎర్రర్ మెసేజ్ అంటే ఏమిటి? దీని అర్థం ఫైల్ కనుగొనబడలేదు. మంచి కమ్యూనికేషన్ ఎందుకు అంత ముఖ్యమైనది? ఎందుకంటే తప్పుగా అర్థం చేసుకోవడం వలన ప్రాజెక్ట్ విఫలమవుతుంది. మీరు ఈ ఉదయం వార్తలను చదివారా? కేవలం శీర్షికలు మాత్రమే. ఏదైనా ముఖ్యమైన ప్రకటన చేయబడిందా? కొండపై ఉన్న పాత కోటను ఎవరు నిర్మించారు? ఎవరికీ ఖచ్చితంగా తెలియదు, కానీ అది చాలా పురాతనమైనది. విమానం ఎందుకు ఆలస్యం అయింది? ఉదయం ప్రారంభంలో దట్టమైన పొగమంచు ఉంది. మీరు సముద్రంలో ఒక తిమింగల్ని చూశారా? ఒకసారి, సముద్రంలో చాలా దూరంలో ఒక పడవ నుండి. మీరు క్రాస్ వాలిడేషన్ ఎలా పనిచేస్తుందో అర్థం చేసుకున్నారా? నేను అనుకుంటున్నాను. మీరు చూసిన డేటాపై నమూనాను పరీక్షిస్తారు. ఇది అద్భుతంగా ఉంది. మీరు మీ పిల్లిని ఎక్కడ దత్తత తీసుకున్నారు? పట్టణం యొక్క అంచున ఉన్న జంతు ఆశ్రయం నుండి. మీ కొత్త ఉద్యోగంలో మొదటి రోజు ఎలా ఉంది? బిజీగా, కానీ నా సహోద్యోగులు చాలా స్నేహపూర్వకంగా ఉన్నారు. మీరు బీచ్ క్లీనింగ్‌లో స్వచ్ఛందంగా పాల్గొన్నారా? అవును, మేము చాలా చెత్త సంచులు సేకరించాము. నేను దానిని గుర్తుంచుకుంటాను. తుది పరీక్షలో ఏమి కవర్ అవుతుంది? ఈ సెమిస్టర్‌లో మనం చదివిన ప్రతిదీ. మీరు వచ్చే వారం కోసం కొత్త షెడ్యూల్‌ను చూశారా? అవును, సమావేశం మధ్యాహ్నానికి మార్చబడింది. తెలుసుకోవడం మంచిది, ధన్యవాదాలు. శీతాకాలంలో పర్వత రోడ్లు తెరిచి ఉన్నాయా? లేదు, అవి సాధారణంగా మంచు కారణంగా మూసివేయబడ్డాయి. విమానాశ్రయం నగర కేంద్రం నుండి ఎంత దూరంలో ఉంది? లేదు, రైలు సుమారు సగం గంటకు పడుతుంది. ఒక పెద్ద బృందంలో పనిచేయడం కష్టమా? కొన్నిసార్లు, కానీ స్పష్టమైన పాత్రలు దీనిని సులభతరం చేస్తాయి. ఇది అద్భుతంగా ఉంది. బయట వాతావరణం ఎలా ఉంది? చల్లగా మరియు గాలి ఎక్కువగా ఉంది, కాబట్టి వెచ్చని జాకెట్ తీసుకోండి. మీరు బ్రెడ్ ఎలా తయారు చేయడం నేర్చుకున్నారు? నా అమ్మమ్మ నన్ను చిన్నతనంలో నేర్పింది. ఆసక్తికరంగా ఉంది, మరిన్ని చెప్పండి. భాష నేర్చుకోవడంలో కష్టమైన భాగం ఏమిటి? నమ్మకంగా మాట్లాడటం, ముఖ్యంగా ఫోన్‌లో. ఈ మధ్యాహ్నం పిల్లలు ఏమి చేస్తున్నారు? వారు పాఠశాల ముందు మంచు మనిషిని నిర్మిస్తున్నారు. నేను బలమైన పాస్‌వర్డ్‌ను ఉపయోగించాలా? ఖచ్చితంగా. మీకు గుర్తుంచుకోవడం సులభమైన పొడవైన పదబంధాన్ని ఉపయోగించండి. సౌర ఫలకలు విద్యను ఎలా ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తాయి? అవి నేరుగా సూర్యకాంతిని విద్యుత్ శక్తిగా మారుస్తాయి. మనం సమావేశాన్ని మధ్యాహ్నానికి మార్చగలమా? అది నాకు సరిపోతుంది. నేను ఇతరులకు చెబుతాను. ఆసక్తికరంగా ఉంది, మరిన్ని చెప్పండి. మీరు మీ ఫైళ్ళ యొక్క బ్యాకప్ తీసుకున్నారా? తప్పకుండా, నేను ఎల్లప్పుడూ మరొక డ్రైవ్‌లో కాపీని ఉంచుతాను. మీరు ఈ రోజు బాగానే ఉన్నారా? చాలా బాగా, ధన్యవాదాలు. మిగిలినవి నిజంగా సహాయపడ్డాయి. మీరు హోటల్‌లో గదిని బుక్ చేశారా? అవును, సరస్సును చూసే గది. మనం ముగించే ముందు మీకు ఏమైనా ప్రశ్నలు ఉన్నాయా? కేవలం ఒకటి: తదుపరి సెషన్ ఎప్పుడు? ప్రొఫెసర్ గడువుల గురించి కఠినంగా ఉన్నారా? చాలా కఠినంగా, కాబట్టి దయచేసి ఏదీ ఆలస్యంగా సమర్పించవద్దు. మనం హైకింగ్ కోసం ఏమి ప్యాక్ చేయాలి? నీరు, ఆహారం, మ్యాప్ మరియు వెచ్చని దుస్తులు. ఇక్కడ కూడా. మనం ముగించే ముందు ప్రధాన అంశాలను సమీక్షించవచ్చా? మంచి ఆలోచన. వాటిని ఒక్కొక్కటిగా చూద్దాం. మనం మార్కెట్‌లో పండ్లు కొనాలా? అవును, అక్కడ పండ్లు సూపర్ మార్కెట్‌లో ఉన్న వాటి కంటే తాజాగా ఉంటాయి. మీరు ఒక రోజు ఇల్లు కొనాలనుకుంటున్నారా? బహుశా, కానీ ప్రస్తుతానికి అద్దెకు తీసుకోవడం సులభం. జట్టు ఎంత తరచుగా శిక్షణ పొందుతుంది? వారానికి రెండుసార్లు, మరియు ముఖ్యమైన ఆటల ముందు. మీరు చదువుకునేటప్పుడు ఎందుకు అంత ఎక్కువ విరామాలు తీసుకుంటారు? చిన్న విరామాలు ఎక్కువసేపు దృష్టి పెట్టడానికి సహాయపడతాయి. నివేదిక ఎప్పుడు సమర్పించాలి? వారం చివరిలో, సమావేశానికి ముందు. మీ జట్టు శనివారం మ్యాచ్‌లో గెలిచారా? అవును, మేము చివరి కొన్ని నిమిషాల్లో గెలిచాము. ఈ రోజు మీ సహాయానికి ధన్యవాదాలు. ధన్యవాదాలు. వచ్చే వారం కలుద్దాం. రీసైక్లింగ్ నిజంగా విలువైనదేనా? అవును, ఇది వ్యర్థాలను తగ్గిస్తుంది మరియు సహజ వనరులను ఆదా చేస్తుంది.
items.reference_en: How do you manage to save money? I put aside a little every week. That makes sense. Is the author giving a talk at the bookstore? Yes, on Thursday evening, and she will sign copies. Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs? Some jobs will change, and new ones will appear. I had the same experience. What does this error message mean? It means the file could not be found. Why is good communication so important? Because misunderstandings can ruin a project. Did you read the news this morning? Only the headlines. Was something important announced? Who built the old castle on the hill? Nobody knows for sure, but it is very old. Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. Have you ever seen a whale in the wild? Once, from a boat far out at sea. Do you understand how cross validation works? I think so. You test the model on data it has not seen. That sounds wonderful. Where did you adopt your cat? From the animal shelter on the edge of town. How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. I will remember that. What will the final exam cover? Everything we have studied this term. Have you seen the new schedule for next week? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. Good to know, thank you. Are the mountain roads open in winter? No, they are usually closed because of the snow. Is the airport far from the city center? Not really, the train takes about half an hour. Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. That sounds wonderful. What is the weather like outside? It is cold and windy, so bring a warm jacket. Who taught you how to bake bread? My grandmother taught me when I was a child. Interesting, tell me more. What is the hardest part of learning a language? Speaking with confidence, especially on the phone. What are the children doing this afternoon? They are building a snowman in front of the school. Should I use a stronger password? Definitely. Use a long phrase that is easy for you to remember. How do solar panels produce electricity? They turn sunlight directly into electrical energy. Can we move the meeting to the afternoon? That works for me. I will tell the others. Interesting, tell me more. Did you save a backup of your files? Of course, I always keep a copy on another drive. Are you feeling better today? Much better, thank you. The rest really helped. Did you book a room at the hotel? Yes, a room with a view of the lake. Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? Is the professor strict about deadlines? Very strict, so please do not submit anything late. What should we pack for the hike? Water, food, a map and a warm layer. Same here. Shall we review the main points before we finish? Good idea. Let us go through them one by one. Should we buy fruit at the market? Yes, the fruit there is fresher than in the supermarket. Would you like to buy a house one day? Maybe, but for now renting is easier. How often does the team practice? Twice a week, and more before important games. Why do you take so many breaks while studying? Short breaks help me concentrate for longer. When is the report due? At the end of the week, before the meeting. Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes. Thank you for your help today. You are welcome. See you next week. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources.

items.text: کیا آپ نے کبھی کوئی دوسرا زبان سیکھنے کی کوشش کی؟ ہاں، میں ہر روز ایک ایپ کے ساتھ تھوڑا سا۔ زبان سیکھنے کا سب سے مشکل حصہ کیا ہے؟ اعتماد کے ساتھ بات کرنا، خاص طور پر فون پر۔ آپ نے سائنس فیر میں کیا سیکھا؟ یہ کیسے ہے کہ روبوٹ بہت جلد پیکیج کو الگ کر سکتے ہیں۔ کیا آپ کوئی اچھا کتاب تجویز کر سکتے ہیں؟ میں نے ایک ناول مکمل کیا ہے جس میں ایک خاندان کو بیرون ملک منتقل ہونے کے بارے میں لکھا ہے۔ آپ کا پسندیدہ موسم کیا ہے؟ خزاں، جب پتے رنگ بدلتے ہیں۔ آپ کیسے یاد کرتے ہیں کہ آپ کیا پڑھ چکے ہیں؟ میں ہر ایک باب کے بعد ایک مختصر خلاصہ لکھتا ہوں۔ آپ آج رات کیا کھانا چاہتے ہیں؟ کچھ سادہ، شاید سوپ اور تازہ روٹی۔ کیا بچے آج دوپہر کیا کر رہے ہیں؟ وہ اسکول کے سامنے ایک برف کا مردہ بنا رہے ہیں۔ کیا عوامی نقل و حمل ڈرائیو کرنے سے کم ہے؟ عام طور پر، اور یہ ماحول کے لیے بھی بہتر ہے۔ کیا مصنف کتاب کی دکان میں بات کر رہا ہے؟ ہاں، جمعرات کی شام، اور وہ وہاں پر کتابوں پر دستخط بھی کریں گی۔ کیا آپ اکثر گھر پر کھانا پکاتے ہیں؟ تقریباً ہر دن۔ یہ صحت مند اور کم قیمت ہے۔ شمسی پینل بجلی کیسے پیدا کرتے ہیں؟ وہ براہ راست سورج کی روشنی کو الیکٹریکل توانائی میں تبدیل کرتے ہیں۔ کیا آپ نے نئی آرٹ گیلری کا دورہ کیا۔ ابھی نہیں، لیکن مجھے سنا ہے کہ پینٹنگز متاثر کن ہیں۔ آج انٹرنیٹ اتنا سست کیوں ہے؟ طوفان نے علاقے میں کچھ کے سیموں کو نقصان پہنچایا۔ آپ کا نیا کام شروع کرنے کا پہلا دن کیسے گذرا؟ مصروف، لیکن میرے ساتھی بہت دوستانہ تھے۔ کیا آپ نے گزشتہ رات کنسرت سے لطف اندوز ہوا۔ بہت زیادہ۔ آرکیسٹرا بہت اچھا تھا۔ کیا آپ مجھے اس پروگرام میں مدد کر سکتے ہیں؟ ضرور. پہلے مجھے خطے کا پیغام دکھائیں۔ آپ ہر روز کتنی پانی پیتے ہیں؟ کافی نہیں، مجھے واقعی زیادہ پینا چاہیے۔ کیا آپ کتابیں پڑھنا پسند کرتے ہیں یا فلمیں دیکھنا؟ کتابیں، کیونکہ میں خود کہانی کی تصویر بنا سکتا ہوں۔ کیا آپ اپنے بائیک پر کام پر جاتے ہیں؟ جب موسم اچھا ہو، ہاں۔ کیا آپ اپنے کام کو مکمل کرنے سے پہلے کوئی سوال پوچھنا چاہتے ہیں؟ صرف ایک: اگلا سیشن کب ہے؟ اس سال یہ پروجیکٹ کون چلا رہا ہے؟ ڈیزائن ڈپارٹمنٹ سے ایک مدیر۔ پرانے شہروں کو کیوں نہروں کے قریب تعمیر کیا گیا؟ نہریں پانی، کھانا اور نقل و حمل فراہم کرتی تھیں۔ آپ نے اپنے صیح تعطیلات میں کہاں گئے؟ ہم پہاڑوں کے قریب ایک پرسکون گاؤں گئے۔ کیا ہم اپنے کام کو مکمل کرنے سے پہلے اہم نکات کا جائزہ لیں؟ اچھا خیال ہے۔ آئیے ہم انہیں ایک ایک کرکے دیکھیں۔ اس خطے کا پیغام کیا مطلب ہے؟ اس کا مطلب ہے کہ فائل نہیں مل سکی۔ آپ پڑھائی کرتے وقت اتنی زیادہ وقفے کیوں لیتے ہیں؟ مختصر وقفے مجھے طویل عرصے تک متمرکز رہنے میں مدد کرتے ہیں۔ کیا آپ نے صبح اخبار پڑھا؟ صرف اہم خبریں۔ کیا کوئی اہم اعلان ہوا؟ آیا ہوائی اڈہ شہر کے مرکز سے دور ہے؟ نہیں، ٹرین تقریباً نصف گھنٹے میں جاتی ہے۔ یہاں سے دریا تک فاصلہ کتنا ہے؟ تقریباً ایک گھنٹہ جنگل کے ذریعے پیدل۔ کیا آپ کے کتے کو چلنے جانا پسند ہے؟ اس سے اسے بہت پیار ہے، خاص طور پر ندی کے قریب۔ آج آپ کی مدد کے لیے شکریہ۔ آپ کا شکریہ۔ اگلے ہفتے ملیں۔ کیا آپ نے باغ میں کچھ کاشت کیا؟ بالکونی پر کچھ ہریبی اور ٹماٹر۔ کیا آپ نے ٹرین یا بس میں سفر کیا۔ ٹرین، کیونکہ یہ تیز اور زیادہ آرام دہ ہے۔ کیا آپ آج بہتر محسوس کر رہے ہیں؟ بہت بہتر، شکریہ۔ باقی سب مددگار ثابت ہوئے۔ ہم کوہ رفتاری کے لیے کیا پیک کرنا چاہیے؟ پانی، کھانا، ایک نقشہ اور ایک گرم کپڑا۔ کیڑے اتنی اہم کیوں ہیں؟ وہ وہ پودے کو پودا کرتے ہیں جو ہمیں میوہ اور سبزی فراہم کرتے ہیں۔ کیا آپ نے اگلے ہفتے کے لیے نئی شیڈول دیکھی؟ ہاں، میٹنگ دوپہر منتقل کر دی گئی۔

Comment les robots peuvent-ils trier les colis très rapidement.

items.text: 飛行機は遅れた理由は何ですか？最初に朝、濃い霧がありました。野菜の価格が上がったのはなぜですか？夏は非常に乾燥していたので、収穫量は少なくなりました。庭に何か植えましたか？バルコニーにはハーブとトマトをいくつか。今日は助けていただき、ありがとうございます。どういたしまして。来週お会いしましょう。次のバスはいつ出発しますか？10分後、反対側のバス停から。ハイキングに何を持っていけばいいですか？水、食べ物、地図、暖かい服。言語を学ぶのが一番難しいことは何ですか？電話で自信を持って話すことです。冬の山道は開通していますか？いいえ、雪のため通常は閉鎖されています。今日の午後に子供たちは何をしていますか？学校の前で雪だるまを作っています。本を読む方が好きですか、それとも映画を見る方が好きですか？本、なぜなら、自分で物語を想像できるからです。公園でサッカーをしたいですか？たぶん後で、暑すぎない時に。今日は気分はどうですか？ずっと良くなりました、ありがとうございます。それのおかげです。最終試験は何を問うのですか？今学期に学んだすべての内容。終わる前に質問はありますか？ただ一つだけ：次のセッションはいつですか？新しい仕事の最初の日はどうでしたか？忙しかったですが、同僚はとても親切でした。なぜ今日インターネットが遅いのですか？嵐がその地域のケーブルを損傷させました。今夜の勉強会に参加しますか？参加したいのですが、遅くまで仕事があります。昨夜のコンサートは楽しめましたか？とても楽しかったです。オーケストラは素晴らしかったです。どんな音楽が好きですか？落ち着いた音楽が好きで、リラックスできます。なぜモデルが新しいデータでうまく機能しないのですか？トレーニングの例を記憶してしまうからです。あなたは海でイルカを見たことがありますか？船から遠くの海で見ました。チームはどのくらいの頻度で練習しますか？毎週2回、重要な試合の前に。今夜は何を食べたいですか？簡単なもの、例えばスープとパンはいかがですか。なぜ良いコミュニケーションが重要なのでしょうか？誤解がプロジェクトを台無しにする可能性があるからです。リサイクルは本当に価値がありますか？
items.reference_en: Why was the flight delayed? There was thick fog early in the morning. Why did the price of vegetables go up? The summer was very dry, so the harvest was small. Have you planted anything in the garden? Some herbs and tomatoes on the balcony. Thank you for your help today. You are welcome. See you next week. When does the next bus leave? In ten minutes, from the stop across the street. What should we pack for the hike? Water, food, a map and a warm layer. What is the hardest part of learning a language? Speaking with confidence, especially on the phone. Are the mountain roads open in winter? No, they are usually closed because of the snow. What are the children doing this afternoon? They are building a snowman in front of the school. Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Books, because I can imagine the story myself. Do you want to play football in the park? Maybe later, when it is not so hot. Are you feeling better today? Much better, thank you. The rest really helped. What will the final exam cover? Everything we have studied this term. Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. Why is the internet so slow today? The storm damaged some of the cables in the area. Are you coming to the study group this evening? I would like to, but I have to work until late. Did you enjoy the concert last night? Very much. The orchestra was wonderful. What kind of music do you enjoy? Mostly calm music that helps me relax. Why does the model perform badly on new data? Because it memorized the training examples instead of learning patterns. Have you ever seen a whale in the wild? Once, from a boat far out at sea. How often does the team practice? Twice a week, and more before important games. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Why is good communication so important? Because misunderstandings can ruin a project. Is recycling really worth the effort?

items.name: Korean
items.text: 보고서 제출 기한은 언제인가요? 이번 주말, 회의 전에. 오늘 아침 뉴스 보셨나요? 오직 헤드라인만. 중요한 내용이 발표되었나요? 의사가 어떤 조언을 해 주셨나요? 물을 많이 마시고 휴식을 취하라고 말씀하셨습니다. 오늘 도움 주셔서 감사합니다. 천만에요. 다음 주에 뵙겠습니다. 언어를 배우는 가장 어려운 부분은 무엇인가요? 특히 전화로 자신감을 가지고 말하는 것입니다. 좋은 책을 추천해 주실 수 있나요? 저는 최근에 해외로 이주하는 가족에 대한 소설을 읽었어요. 올해 프로젝트를 누가 이끌고 있나요? 디자인 부서의 관리자. 오늘 오후에 아이들은 무엇을 하고 있나요? 학교 앞에서는 눈사람을 만들고 있어요. 언덕에 있는 오래된 성을 누가 지었나요? 확실히 알 수 없지만, 매우 오래되었습니다. 오늘 저녁에 무엇을 먹고 싶으세요? 간단한 것, 아마도 수프와 신선한 빵. 어제 일몰을 보셨나요? 네, 하늘 전체가 주황색과 분홍색으로 변했어요. 더 강력한 비밀번호를 사용해야 할까요? 물론입니다. 기억하기 쉬운 긴 문장을 사용하세요. 근처에 좋은 식당을 추천해 주실 수 있나요? 코너에 있는 작은 식당에서 훌륭한 국수를 제공합니다. 큰 팀에서 일하는 것이 어렵나요? 가끔은, 명확한 역할이 더 쉬워집니다. 누가 빵을 굽는 법을 가르쳐 주셨나요? 제 할머니가 어린 시절에 저에게 가르쳐 주셨습니다. 새로운 직장에서 첫 날은 어떠셨나요? 바쁘지만, 동료들이 매우 친절했습니다. 자전거를 타고 출근하시나요? 날씨가 좋을 때, 네. 새로운 미술관에 방문해 보셨나요? 아직은 못 가봤지만, 그림이 인상적이라고 들었습니다. 끝내기 전에 질문이 있나요? 단 하나: 다음 세션은 언제인가요? 토요일에 팀이 경기를 이겼나요? 네, 마지막 몇 분에 이겼습니다. 해변 청소에 자원했나요? 네, 많은 쓰레기를 모았습니다. 왜 고대 도시들이 강가에 지어졌을까요? 강은 물, 식량, 교통을 제공했습니다. 언젠가 집을 사는 것을 원하시나요? 아마도, 하지만 지금은 임대하는 것이 더 쉬워요. 왜 벌이 그렇게 중요할까요? 과일과 채소를 주는 식물을 수분시킵니다. 모델이 새로운 데이터에서 왜 잘 작동하지 않나요? 훈련 예제를 학습하는 대신 암기했기 때문입니다. 이 오류 메시지가 무슨 뜻인가요? 파일이 찾을 수 없다는 뜻입니다. 축제를 방문할 가치가 있나요? 물론입니다. 많은 나라에서 사람들이 옵니다. 다른 언어를 배우는 것을 시도해 본 적이 있나요? 네, 앱을 사용하여 매일 조금 연습합니다. 책을 읽는 것을 선호하시나요, 아니면 영화를 보는 것을 선호하시나요? 책, 왜냐하면 저 스스로 이야기를 상상할 수 있기 때문입니다. 겨울에 산길이 열려 있나요? 아니요, 보통 눈 때문에 닫혀 있습니다. 시험 전에 어디에서 만나면 좋을까요? 도서관 앞에서 조금 일찍 만나요. 매일 물을 얼마나 마시나요? 충분하지 않아요, 정말 더 마셔야 해요. 읽은 내용을 어떻게 기억하시나요? 저는 각 장마다 짧은 요약을 쓰고 있어요. 파일의 백업을 저장했나요? 물론, 항상 다른 드라이브에 복사본을 보관합니다. 오늘 저녁 스터디 그룹에 오시나요? 가고 싶지만, 늦게까지 일해야 해요. 이 프로그램에 대해 도와주시겠어요? 네. 먼저 오류 메시지를 보여주세요. 정부는 무엇을 발표했나요? 농촌 지역 도로 개선을 위한 새로운 계획. 교차 검증이 어떻게 작동하는지 이해하나요? 네, 그렇게 생각해요. 모델은 본 적 없는 데이터에 테스트를 합니다. 집에서 자주 요리하시나요? 거의 매일. 건강하고 저렴합니다. 당신은 강아지를 어디에서 입양했나요? 시내 외곽의 동물 보호소에서요. 혹시 바다에서 고래를 본 적이 있나요? 한 번, 멀리 떨어진 바다에서 배를 타고. 교수님은 마감일을 엄격하게 지키나요? 매우 엄격하므로, 늦게 제출하지 마세요. 오늘 아침 강의에 대해 어떻게 생각하셨나요? 흥미로웠어요, 특히 훈련 데이터에 대한 부분이요. 발표에 대해 걱정되세요? 조금, 하지만 여러 번 연습했어요. 일하기 전에 또는 후에 운동을 하시나요? 보통 아침, 사무실이 문을 여는 전에. 재활용이 정말 가치가 있을까요? 네, 쓰레기를 줄이고 천연 자원을 절약합니다. 시험 중에 메모를 사용할 수 있나요? 아니요, 휴대폰은 끄세요. 돈을 모으는 방법이 궁금해요.
items.reference_en: When is the report due? At the end of the week, before the meeting. Did you read the news this morning? Only the headlines. Was something important announced? Did the doctor give you any advice? She told me to rest and drink plenty of water. Thank you for your help today. You are welcome. See you next week. What is the hardest part of learning a language? Speaking with confidence, especially on the phone. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. Who is leading the project this year? The manager from the design department. What are the children doing this afternoon? They are building a snowman in front of the school. Who built the old castle on the hill? Nobody knows for sure, but it is very old. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Did you see the sunset yesterday? Yes, the whole sky turned orange and pink. Should I use a stronger password? Definitely. Use a long phrase that is easy for you to remember. Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby? The small place on the corner serves excellent noodles. Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. Who taught you how to bake bread? My grandmother taught me when I was a child. How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. Do you ride your bicycle to work? When the weather is good, yes. Have you visited the new art gallery? Not yet, but I heard the paintings are impressive. Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes. Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. Would you like to buy a house one day? Maybe, but for now renting is easier. Why are bees so important? They pollinate the plants that give us fruit and vegetables. Why does the model perform badly on new data? Because it memorized the training examples instead of learning patterns. What does this error message mean? It means the file could not be found. Is the festival worth visiting? Absolutely. People come from many countries. Have you ever tried learning a second language? Yes, I practice a little every day with an app. Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Books, because I can imagine the story myself. Are the mountain roads open in winter? No, they are usually closed because of the snow. Where should we meet before the exam? Let us meet in front of the library a little early. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. How do you remember what you read? I write a short summary after each chapter. Did you save a backup of your files? Of course, I always keep a copy on another drive. Are you coming to the study group this evening? I would like to, but I have to work until late. Can you help me with this program? Sure. Show me the error message first. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. Do you understand how cross validation works? I think so. You test the model on data it has not seen. Do you cook at home very often? Almost every day. It is healthier and cheaper. Where did you adopt your cat? From the animal shelter on the edge of town. Have you ever seen a whale in the wild? Once, from a boat far out at sea. Is the professor strict about deadlines? Very strict, so please do not submit anything late. What did you think of the lecture this morning? It was interesting, especially the part about training data. Are you nervous about the presentation? A little, but I have practiced it several times. Do you exercise before or after work? Usually in the morning, before the office opens. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources. Are we allowed to use notes during the exam? No, and phones must be switched off. How do you manage to save money?

items.name: Vietnamese
items.text: Bạn đã từng thử học một ngôn ngữ thứ hai chưa? Có, tôi luyện tập một chút mỗi ngày với một ứng dụng. Tại sao các thành phố cổ lại được xây dựng gần sông? Sông cung cấp nước, thức ăn và phương tiện vận chuyển. Các tấm pin mặt trời tạo ra điện bằng cách nào? Chúng chuyển trực tiếp ánh sáng mặt trời thành năng lượng điện. Có khó khăn khi làm việc trong một nhóm lớn không? Đôi khi, nhưng vai trò rõ ràng giúp dễ dàng hơn. Tại sao ong lại quan trọng đến vậy? Chúng thụ phấn cho các loại cây cho chúng ta trái cây và rau. Bạn đã ngủ ngon vào tối qua không? Không ngon. Các hàng xóm đang chơi nhạc ồn. Chính phủ đã thông báo điều gì? Một kế hoạch mới để cải thiện đường ở vùng nông thôn. Bạn có muốn mua một căn nhà vào một ngày nào đó không? Có thể, nhưng hiện tại thuê nhà dễ hơn. Bạn thích loại nhạc nào? Chủ yếu là nhạc nhẹ giúp tôi thư giãn. Bạn uống bao nhiêu nước mỗi ngày? Không đủ, tôi thực sự nên uống nhiều hơn. Chúng ta có nên xem lại các điểm chính trước khi kết thúc không? Ý tưởng hay. Hãy đi qua từng cái một. Ngày đầu tiên của bạn tại công việc mới như thế nào? Bận rộn, nhưng đồng nghiệp của tôi rất thân thiện. Chúng ta nên chuẩn bị gì cho chuyến đi bộ đường dài? Nước, thức ăn, bản đồ và một lớp quần áo ấm. Có mưa vào cuối tuần không? Dự báo có mưa nhỏ vào Chủ nhật. Bạn có thể gợi ý một nhà hàng ngon gần đây không? Quán nhỏ ở góc phố phục vụ mì rất ngon. Bạn đã đọc tin tức sáng nay chưa? Chỉ là tiêu đề. Có thông báo gì quan trọng không? Bạn có thể giới thiệu một cuốn sách hay không? Thông báo lỗi này có nghĩa là gì? Nó có nghĩa là tệp không thể tìm thấy. Bạn đi tàu hay xe buýt? Tàu, vì nó nhanh hơn và thoải mái hơn. Sân bay cách trung tâm thành phố đến bao xa? Không thực sự, tàu hỏa mất khoảng nửa giờ. Bạn thích đọc sách hay xem phim hơn? Sách, vì tôi có thể tự tưởng tượng câu chuyện. Bạn có hiểu cách cross validation hoạt động không? Tôi nghĩ vậy. Bạn kiểm tra mô hình trên dữ liệu mà nó chưa thấy. Bạn đã học được gì tại hội chợ khoa học? Cách robot có thể sắp xếp hàng hóa rất nhanh chóng. Bạn có tham gia dọn dẹp bãi biển không? Có, chúng tôi đã thu gom rất nhiều túi rác. Bạn đã đến thăm phòng trưng bày nghệ thuật mới chưa? Chưa, nhưng tôi nghe nói các bức tranh rất ấn tượng. Bạn tập thể dục trước hay sau khi làm việc? Thường là vào buổi sáng, trước khi văn phòng mở cửa. Đội của bạn đã thắng trận vào thứ Bảy chưa? Có, chúng tôi đã thắng trong những phút cuối cùng.
items.reference_en: Have you ever tried learning a second language? Yes, I practice a little every day with an app. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. How do solar panels produce electricity? They turn sunlight directly into electrical energy. Is it difficult to work in a large team? Sometimes, but clear roles make it easier. Why are bees so important? They pollinate the plants that give us fruit and vegetables. How did you sleep last night? Badly. The neighbors were playing loud music. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. Would you like to buy a house one day? Maybe, but for now renting is easier. What kind of music do you enjoy? Mostly calm music that helps me relax. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. Shall we review the main points before we finish? Good idea. Let us go through them one by one. How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. What should we pack for the hike? Water, food, a map and a warm layer. Will it rain this weekend? The forecast says there will be light rain on Sunday. Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby? The small place on the corner serves excellent noodles. Did you read the news this morning? Only the headlines. Was something important announced? Can you recommend a good book? What does this error message mean? It means the file could not be found. Did you take the train or the bus? The train, because it is faster and more comfortable. Is the airport far from the city center? Not really, the train takes about half an hour. Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Books, because I can imagine the story myself. Do you understand how cross validation works? I think so. You test the model on data it has not seen. What did you learn at the science fair? How robots can sort packages very quickly. Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. Have you visited the new art gallery? Not yet, but I heard the paintings are impressive. Do you exercise before or after work? Usually in the morning, before the office opens. Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes.

items.name: Thai
items.text: การรีไซเคิลคุ้มค่าหรือไม่?คุณรับเลี้ยงแมวมาจากที่ไหน?จากศูนย์พักสัตว์ใกล้เมืองพวกเราไปเที่ยวหมู่บ้านที่เงียบสงบใกล้ภูเขา.งานเทศกาลคุ้มค่าที่จะไปหรือไม่?แน่นอน ผู้คนมาจากหลายประเทศสิ้นสุดสัปดาห์ ก่อนการประชุมเราควรเตรียมอะไรสำหรับการเดินป่า?ฉันเก็บเงินเล็กน้อยทุกสัปดาห์เราสามารถใช้โน้ตในการสอบได้หรือไม่?คุณเคยเห็นปลาวาฬในธรรมชาติหรือไม่?ครั้งหนึ่ง, จากเรือที่อยู่ไกลออกทะเลคุณกังวลเกี่ยวกับการนำเสนอหรือไม่?นิดหน่อย แต่ฉันได้ฝึกซ้อมมาหลายครั้งแล้วฉันเพิ่งอ่านนวนิยายเกี่ยวกับครอบครัวที่ย้ายไปต่างประเทศงานบางอย่างจะเปลี่ยนแปลง และงานใหม่จะเกิดขึ้นคอมพิวเตอร์ของคุณทำงานได้อีกแล้วไหม?ใช่, การอัปเดตแก้ไขปัญหาทีมฝึกซ้อมบ่อยแค่ไหน?สองครั้งต่อสัปดาห์ และบ่อยกว่าก่อนเกมสำคัญไม่มีใครรู้แน่ชัด แต่เป็นปราสาทที่เก่ามากพิพิธภัณฑ์เปิดในวันจันทร์ไหม?ไม่, ปิดในวันจันทร์ แต่เปิดในวันอื่นๆทำไมอินเทอร์เน็ตถึงช้าในวันนี้?พายุทำให้สายเคเบิลบางส่วนในบริเวณนั้นเสียหายแม่น้ำให้แหล่งน้ำ อาหาร และการขนส่งการสอบครั้งสุดท้ายจะครอบคลุมอะไรบ้าง?ทุกสิ่งที่เราได้เรียนมาตลอดเทอมคุณอยากทานอะไรในเย็นนี้?อะไรที่เรียบง่าย, อาจจะเป็นซุปและขนมปังสดอะไรทำให้เกิดน้ำขึ้นและน้ำลงในทะเล?ส่วนใหญ่เป็นแรงดึงดูดของดวงจันทร์ในเวลา 10 นาที, จากจุดที่อยู่ตรงข้ามถนนอาจารย์เข้มงวดเกี่ยวกับกำหนดเวลาหรือไม่?เข้มงวดมาก ดังนั้นโปรดอย่าส่งงานช้า.คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำอะไรคุณบ้าง?เธอแนะนำให้ฉันพักผ่อนและดื่มน้ำเยอะๆทำไมราคาผักถึงขึ้น?ฤดูร้อนเป็นฤดูที่แห้งแล้ง ทำให้ผลผลิตน้อยคุณทำอาหารที่บ้านบ่อยแค่ไหน?คุณอ่านข่าวเช้านี้แล้วหรือเปล่า?คุณได้เรียนรู้อะไรบ้างในการงานวิทยาศาสตร์?วิธีที่หุ่นยนต์สามารถคัดแยกบรรจุภัณฑ์ได้อย่างรวดเร็วทีมของคุณชนะการแข่งขันในวันเสาร์หรือไม่?ใช่, เราชนะในช่วงนาทีสุดท้ายเราสามารถย้ายการประชุมไปช่วงบ่ายได้ไหม?นั่นเหมาะกับฉัน ฉันจะบอกคนอื่นเราควรซื้อผลไม้ที่ตลาดไหม?ใช่, ผลไม้ที่นั่นสดกว่าในซูเปอร์มาร์เก็ตคุณจองห้องพักที่โรงแรมหรือไม่?คุณเคยลองเรียนภาษาที่สองไหม?ใช่, ฉันฝึกทุกวันด้วยแอปเมื่ออากาศดี ใช่แผงโซลาร์เซลล์ผลิตไฟฟ้าได้อย่างไร?พวกมันเปลี่ยนแสงอาทิตย์ให้เป็นพลังงานไฟฟ้าโดยตรงไม่, โดยปกติแล้วปิดเนื่องจากหิมะพยากรณ์อากาศบอกว่าจะมีฝนเล็กน้อยในวันอาทิตย์.ฉันควรใช้รหัสผ่านที่แข็งแกร่งหรือไม่?แน่นอน. ใช้คำที่ยาวซึ่งคุณจำได้ง่ายแน่นอน เราแบ่งข้อมูลและเปรียบเทียบผลลัพธ์.ฉันคิดว่าใช่ คุณทดสอบโมเดลกับข้อมูลที่ไม่เคยเห็น.ขอบคุณสำหรับความช่วยเหลือในวันนี้การทำงานในทีมขนาดใหญ่เป็นเรื่องยากหรือไม่?บางครั้ง แต่บทบาทที่ชัดเจนทำให้ง่ายขึ้นคุณชอบเพลงแบบไหน?การทำงานกับทีมที่สื่อสารกันได้คุณเคยไปที่แกลเลอรี่ศิลปะใหม่ไหม?คุณชอบอ่านหนังสือหรือดูภาพยนตร์มากกว่า?หนังสือ, เพราะฉันสามารถจินตนาการเรื่องราวได้เองวิศวกรสามารถทำให้รถใช้พลังงานน้อยลงได้อย่างไร?ส่วนใหญ่เป็นช่วงบ่าย เพราะฉันทำผิดพลาดตั้งแต่ต้น.วันแรกที่ทำงานใหม่ของคุณเป็นอย่างไร?คึกคัก, แต่เพื่อนร่วมงานเป็นมิตรมากส่วนที่ยากที่สุดในการเรียนภาษาคืออะไร?การพูดด้วยความมั่นใจ, โดยเฉพาะตอนโทรศัพท์คุณได้สำรองข้อมูลไฟล์ของคุณไหม?แน่นอน, ฉันเก็บสำเนาไว้ในไดรฟ์อื่นเสมอฉันอยากไป แต่ฉันต้องทำงานจนดึก.สุนัขของคุณชอบออกไปเดินเล่นไหม?ทำไมเที่ยวบินถึงล่าช้า?มีหมอกหนาในตอนเช้าคุณช่วยฉันกับโปรแกรมนี้ได้ไหม?ได้ค่ะ. ให้ฉันดูข้อความผิดพลาดก่อนคุณเห็นพระอาทิตย์ตกเมื่อวานหรือไม่?ใช่ ท้องฟ้าทั้งใบเปลี่ยนเป็นสีส้มและชมพูทะเลอยู่ห่างจากที่นี่กี่นาที?ประมาณหนึ่งชั่วโมงโดยเท้าผ่านป่ารถไฟ เพราะมันเร็วกว่าและสะดวกสบายกว่า.ทำไมโมเดลถึงทำงานได้ไม่ดีกับข้อมูลใหม่?เพราะมันจำตัวอย่างการฝึกแทนที่จะเรียนรู้รูปแบบ.ใครสอนให้คุณทำขนมปัง?ยายสอนฉันตอนที่ฉันยังเด็กไอเดียที่ดี ให้เราทำทีละอย่างคุณอยากเล่นฟุตบอลในสวนหรือไม่?บางที, เมื่ออากาศไม่ร้อนมากแค่หนึ่งข้อ: การประชุมครั้งต่อไปคือเมื่อไหร่?เราควรนัดพบกันที่ไหนก่อนสอบ?คุณได้เข้าร่วมกิจกรรมทำความสะอาดชายหาดหรือไม่?ใช่ เราได้เก็บขยะจำนวนมากดีขึ้นมาก, ขอบคุณ. สิ่งอื่นๆ ช่วยได้มากจริงๆคุณอยากซื้อบ้านไหม?บางที แต่ตอนนี้การเช่าบ้านง่ายกว่าเด็กๆ กำลังทำอะไรช่วงบ่าย?ฤดูกาลที่คุณชอบคืออะไร?ฤดูใบไม้ร่วง เมื่อใบไม้เปลี่ยนสีทำไมคุณถึงพักบ่อยตอนอ่านหนังสือ?สนามบินอยู่ไกลจากใจกลางเมืองหรือไม่?ไม่, รถไฟใช้เวลาประมาณครึ่งชั่วโมงคุณเห็นตารางใหม่สำหรับสัปดาห์หน้าหรือไม่?คุณจำสิ่งที่อ่านได้อย่างไร?ฉันเขียนสรุปสั้นๆ หลังจากการอ่านแต่ละบทคุณออกกำลังกายก่อนหรือหลังทำงาน?โดยปกติคือตอนเช้า, ก่อนที่สำนักงานจะเปิดข้อความผิดพลาดนี้หมายความว่าอย่างไร?หมายความว่าไฟล์ไม่สามารถพบได้การเดินทางสาธารณะถูกกว่าการขับรถหรือไม่?

Bolehkah anda mengesyorkan restoran yang baik di sini? Tempat kecil di sudut itu menyajikan mi yang sangat enak. Adakah anda berasa lebih baik hari ini? Sangat baik, terima kasih. Yang lain benar-benar membantu. Adakah anda pernah mencuba belajar bahasa kedua? Ya, saya berlatih sedikit setiap hari dengan aplikasi. Apa yang anda suka daripada kerja anda? Adakah anda mempunyai soalan sebelum kita berakhir? Hanya satu: bila sesi berikutnya? Jenis muzik apa yang anda nikmati? Kebanyakan muzik yang tenang yang membantu saya untuk bersantai. Adakah kitaran benar-benar berbaloi? Ya, ia mengurangkan sisa dan menjimatkan sumber semula jadi. Apa maksud mesej kesilapan ini? Ini bermaksud fail tidak dapat ditemui. Adakah saya perlu menggunakan kata laluan yang lebih kuat? Tentu. Gunakan frasa yang panjang yang mudah untuk anda ingat. Mengapa bandar-bandar purba dibina berhampiran sungai? Sungai menyediakan air, makanan dan pengangkutan. Adakah anda pernah melihat paus di alam semula jadi? Kadang-kadang, dari perahu jauh di laut. Apa yang menyebabkan gelombang di laut? Terutamanya tarikan bulan ke air. Bolehkah anda mengesyorkan buku yang baik? Saya baru sahaja menyelesaikan novel tentang keluarga yang berpindah ke luar negara. Mengapa model itu berprestasi buruk pada data baharu? Kerana ia mengingati contoh latihan daripada belajar corak. Adakah anda memasak di rumah dengan kerap? Hampir setiap hari. Ia lebih sihat dan murah. Adakah anda lebih suka membaca buku atau menonton filem? Buku, kerana saya boleh membayangkan cerita itu sendiri. Adakah anda pernah mengunjungi galeri seni baharu? Belum, tetapi saya telah mendengar bahawa lukisan itu menarik. Bagaimana hari pertama anda di pekerjaan baru? Sibuk, tetapi rakan sekerja saya sangat mesra. Adakah anda membaca berita pagi ini? Hanya tajuk utama. Adakah sesuatu penting yang diumumkan? Mengapa internet begitu lambat hari ini? Hujan telah merosakkan beberapa kabel di kawasan itu. Kapan laporan itu perlu dihantar? Pada akhir minggu, sebelum mesyuarat. Apa yang anda pelajari di pameran sains? Bagaimana robot boleh menyortkan bungkusan dengan sangat pantas. Rencana baharu untuk meningkatkan jalan-jalan di kawasan luar bandar. Mengapa lebah begitu penting? Mereka mempolinasi tumbuhan yang memberi kita buah dan sayur. Adakah doktor memberi anda sebarang nasihat? Dia memberi saya nasihat untuk beristirahat dan minum banyak air.
items.reference_en: Did you volunteer at the beach cleanup? Yes, we collected many bags of rubbish. Thank you for your help today. You are welcome. See you next week. How far is the lake from here? About an hour on foot through the forest. What did you think of the lecture this morning? It was interesting, especially the part about training data. Did you book a room at the hotel? Yes, a room with a view of the lake. Are you coming to the study group this evening? I would like to, but I have to work until late. Can you help me with this program? Sure. Show me the error message first. Is the author giving a talk at the bookstore? Yes, on Thursday evening, and she will sign copies. Did you finish reading the chapter for today? Yes, I read it last night, but the second half was difficult. Where did you go on your summer holiday? We visited a quiet village near the mountains. Could you explain the last example again? Of course. We split the data and compare the results. Who is leading the project this year? The manager from the design department. Why did the price of vegetables go up? The summer was very dry, so the harvest was small. Where did you adopt your cat? From the animal shelter on the edge of town. What is your favorite season? Autumn, when the leaves change color. How was the trip to the coast? Beautiful. We walked along the beach every evening. Who built the old castle on the hill? Nobody knows for sure, but it is very old. Can we move the meeting to the afternoon? That works for me. I will tell the others. How often does the team practice? Twice a week, and more before important games. Will it rain this weekend? The forecast says there will be light rain on Sunday. Is the professor strict about deadlines? Very strict, so please do not submit anything late. Did you enjoy the concert last night? Very much. The orchestra was wonderful. Did you see the sunset yesterday? Yes, the whole sky turned orange and pink. When does the next bus leave? In ten minutes, from the stop across the street. Is the festival worth visiting? Absolutely. People come from many countries. How do solar panels produce electricity? They turn sunlight directly into electrical energy. How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. Are we allowed to use notes during the exam? No, and phones must be switched off. Are you nervous about the presentation? A little, but I have practiced it several times. How did you sleep last night? Badly. The neighbors were playing loud music. What is the weather like outside? It is cold and windy, so bring a warm jacket. What would you like to eat tonight? Something simple, maybe soup and fresh bread. Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby? The small place on the corner serves excellent noodles. Are you feeling better today? Much better, thank you. The rest really helped. Have you ever tried learning a second language? Yes, I practice a little every day with an app. What do you like most about your work? Working with a team that communicates well. What should we pack for the hike? Water, food, a map and a warm layer. Is the museum open on Mondays? No, it is closed on Mondays but open the rest of the week. Did your team win the match on Saturday? Yes, we won in the last few minutes. How do you manage to save money? I put aside a little every week. Did you save a backup of your files? Of course, I always keep a copy on another drive. Do you have any questions before we end? Just one: when is the next session? What kind of music do you enjoy? Mostly calm music that helps me relax. Is recycling really worth the effort? Yes, it reduces waste and saves natural resources. What does this error message mean? It means the file could not be found. Do you exercise before or after work? Usually in the morning, before the office opens. Do you ride your bicycle to work? When the weather is good, yes. Should I use a stronger password? Definitely. Use a long phrase that is easy for you to remember. Why were ancient cities built near rivers? Rivers provided water, food and transport. Have you ever seen a whale in the wild? Once, from a boat far out at sea. What causes the tides in the ocean? Mainly the pull of the moon on the water. Can you recommend a good book? I just finished a novel about a family moving abroad. Why does the model perform badly on new data? Because it memorized the training examples instead of learning patterns. Do you cook at home very often? Almost every day. It is healthier and cheaper. Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Books, because I can imagine the story myself. Have you visited the new art gallery? Not yet, but I heard the paintings are impressive. How was your first day at the new job? Busy, but my colleagues were very friendly. Did you read the news this morning? Only the headlines. Was something important announced? Why is the internet so slow today? The storm damaged some of the cables in the area. When is the report due? At the end of the week, before the meeting. What did you learn at the science fair? How robots can sort packages very quickly. Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs? Some jobs will change, and new ones will appear. What did the government announce? A new plan to improve roads in rural areas. Why are bees so important? They pollinate the plants that give us fruit and vegetables. Did the doctor give you any advice? She told me to rest and drink plenty of water.

items.name: Filipino (Tagalog)
items.text: Ilang tubig ang iniinom mo araw-araw? Hindi sapat, dapat talaga akong uminom ng mas marami. Nakita mo na ba ang bagong iskedyul para sa susunod na linggo? Oo, inilipat ang pagpupulong sa hapon. Maaari mo bang irekomenda ang isang magandang restaurant sa malapit? Ang maliit na lugar sa sulok ay naghahain ng mahusay na noodles. Paano ka natulog kahapon? Hindi maganda. Naglalaro ang mga kapitbahay ng malakas na musika. Kailan ang takdang oras ng ulat? Sa katapusan ng linggo, bago ang pagpupulong. Gaano kalayo ang lawa mula dito? Mga isang oras sa pamamagitan ng paglalakad sa gubat. Bukas ba ang mga kalsada sa bundok sa taglamig? Hindi, karaniwang sarado dahil sa niyebe. Nag-eehersisyo ka ba bago o pagkatapos ng trabaho? Kadalasan sa umaga, bago magbukas ang opisina. Mag-uulan ba sa weekend? Sinasabi ng forecast na may magiging magaan na ulan sa Linggo. Bakit mabagal ang internet ngayon? Nasira ng bagyo ang ilang kable sa lugar. Mas gusto mo ba ang pagbabasa ng libro o panonood ng pelikula? Libro, dahil kaya kong isipin ang kuwento. Anong uri ng musika ang gusto mo? Karaniwan, tahimik na musika na nakakatulong sa akin na magrelaks. Sino ang nangunguna sa proyekto ngayong taon? Ang manager mula sa departamento ng disenyo. Gusto mo bang maglaro ng football sa parke? Baka mamaya, kapag hindi masyadong mainit. Paano maaaring gumawa ng mga inhinyero ng mga sasakyan na gumagamit ng mas kaunting enerhiya? Sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng mga ito na mas magaan at mas mahusay. Makakatuwa bang bisitahin ang festival? Oo naman. Dumadayo ang mga tao mula sa maraming bansa. Bukas ba ang museo sa Lunes? Hindi, sarado ito sa Lunes ngunit bukas ang natitirang bahagi ng linggo. Paano ang iyong unang araw sa bagong trabaho? Abala, ngunit ang aking mga kasamahan ay napaka-friendly. Madalas ka bang nagluluto sa bahay? Halos araw-araw. Mas malusog at mas mura. Paano mo nasusuyod ang pera? Naglalagay ako ng kaunti bawat linggo. Ano ang iyong paboritong panahon? Taglagas, kapag nagbago ang kulay ng mga dahon. Gusto ba ng iyong aso ang maglakad? Gusto niya, lalo na malapit sa ilog. Nakita mo na ba ang isang balyena sa labas? Isang beses, mula sa isang bangka malayo sa dagat. Mahirap ba magtrabaho sa isang malaking grupo? Minsan, ngunit ang malinaw na papel ay nagpapadali. Nanalo ba ang iyong team sa laban noong Sabado? Oo, nanalo kami sa huling ilang minuto. Bakit tumaas ang presyo ng mga gulay? Napakainit ng tag-init, kaya maliit lang ang ani. Paano gumagawa ng kuryente ang mga solar panel? Ginagawa nila ang liwanag ng araw na direktang enerhiya. Paano mo maalala ang nabasa mo? Sumusulat ako ng maikling buod pagkatapos ng bawat kabanata. Tapos na ba ninyong basahin ang kaban sa araw na ito? Oo, nabasa ko ito kahapon, ngunit mahirap ang ikalawang bahagi. Pinapayagan ba tayong gumamit ng notes sa exam? Hindi, at dapat patayin ang mga cellphone. Saan mo nakuha ang iyong pusa? Mula sa animal shelter sa gilid ng bayan. Ano ang iniisip mo tungkol sa lektura ngayong umaga? Nakakainteres, lalo na ang bahagi tungkol sa data ng pagsasanay. Gaano kadalas nag-eensayo ang team? Dalawang beses sa isang linggo, at mas madalas bago ang mahalagang mga laro. Dapat ba tayong bumili ng prutas sa palengke? Oo, mas sariwa ang prutas doon kaysa sa supermarket. Bakit ka nagkakaroon ng maraming pahinga habang nag-aaral? Nakakatulong ang maikling pahinga para mas mag-focus. Nais mo bang matutunan ang pangalawang wika? Oo, nagpraktis ako araw-araw gamit ang isang app. Nabasa mo ba ang balita sa umaga? Lamang ang mga pamagat. May mahalagang anunsyo ba? Maaari mo bang ipaliwanag muli ang huling halimbawa? Syempre. Hinahati natin ang data at ikumpara ang mga resulta. Talaga bang sulit ang pag-recycle? Oo, binabawasan nito ang basura at nakakatipid ng natural na yaman. Bakit mahalaga ang magandang komunikasyon? Dahil ang maling pag-unawa ay maaaring sirain ang isang proyekto. Ano ang ginagawa ng mga bata ngayong hapon? Nagtatayo sila ng snowman sa harap ng paaralan. Ano ang lagay ng panahon sa labas? Malamig at maalon, kaya magdala ng mainit na jacket. Bakit naantala ang flight? May makapal na fog sa maagang umaga. Sino ang nagtayo ng lumang kastilyo sa burol? Walang nakakaalam, ngunit ito ay napakaluma. Malayo ba ang airport sa sentro ng lungsod? Hindi naman, ang tren ay tumatagal ng mga kalahating oras. Gusto mo bang bumili ng bahay isang araw? Baka, pero sa ngayon mas madali ang pagrenta. Nagbigay ba ang doktor ng anumang payo? Sabi niya, magpahinga at uminom ng maraming tubig. Sino ang nagturo sa iyo kung paano maghurno ng tinapay? Tinuruan ako ng aking lola noong bata pa ako. Mayroon ka bang tanong bago tayo matapos? Isa lang: kailan ang susunod na sesyon? Mahigpit ba ang propesor sa mga deadline? Sobrang mahigpit, kaya mangyaring huwag magsumite ng kahit ano na late. Saan ka pumunta sa iyong bakasyon sa tag-init? Binisita namin ang tahimik na nayon malapit sa bundok. Maaari ba nating ilipat ang pagpupulong sa hapon? Maganda iyon para sa akin. Sasabihin ko sa iba. Nagbibisikleta ka ba papunta sa trabaho? Kapag maganda ang panahon, oo. Dapat ba akong gumamit ng mas malakas na password? Oo naman. Gumamit ng mahabang parirala na madaling tandaan. Ano ang natutunan mo sa science fair? Paano maaaring pagbuktin ng mga robot ang mga package nang napakabilis. Maaari mo bang irekomenda ang isang magandang libro? Kamakailan ko lang natapos ang isang nobela tungkol sa isang pamilya na lumipat sa ibang bansa. Ano ang nagdudulot ng mga alon sa karagatan? Pangunahin, ang grabidad ng buwan sa tubig. Nakita mo ba ang paglubog ng araw kahapon? Oo, buong kalangitan ay naging orange at pink. Nagboluntaryo ka ba sa beach cleanup? Oo, nakolekta kami ng maraming bag ng basura. Ano ang pinakamahirap na bahagi ng pag-aaral ng wika? Magsalita nang may kumpiyansa, lalo na sa telepono. Paano ang biyahe sa baybayin? Napakaganda. Naglakad kami sa beach bawat gabi. Mapapalitan ba ng artificial intelligence ang maraming trabaho? May mga trabaho na magbabago, at may mga bagong trabaho na lalabas. Ano ang gusto mong kainin ngayong gabi? May simpleng bagay, marahil sopas at sariwang tinapay. Saan tayo dapat magkita bago ang pagsusulit? Magkita tayo sa harap ng aklatan, medyo maaga. Mas mura ba ang pampublikong transport kaysa sa pagmamaneho? Kadalasan, at mas mabuti rin ito para sa kapaligiran. Ano ang sakop ng final exam? Lahat ng ating pinag-aralan sa term na ito. Ikaw ba ay kinakabahan tungkol sa presentasyon? Medyo, pero sinanay ko na ito ng maraming beses. Salamat sa iyong tulong ngayon. Walang anuman. Kita tayo sa susunod na linggo. Nag-save ka ba ng backup ng iyong mga file? Syempre, palagi akong may kopya sa ibang drive. Ano ang ibig sabihin ng mensaheng ito? Ibig sabihin, hindi mahanap ang file. Bakit itinayo ang mga sinaunang lungsod malapit sa ilog? Nagbigay ang ilog ng tubig, pagkain, at transportasyon. Ano ang anunsyo ng gobyerno?
items.reference_en: How much water do you drink every day? Not enough, I should really drink more. Have you seen the new schedule for next week? Yes, the meeting was moved to the afternoon. items.text: រដ្ឋាភិបាលបានប្រកាសអ្វី?ផែនការថ្មីមួយដើម្បីអភិវឌ្ឍផ្លូវនៅតំបន់ជនបទ។ខ្ញុំនឹងចាំ.តើដំណើរទៅឆ្នេរសមុទ្រ?ស្រស់ស្អាត។ យើងដើរតាមឆ្នេរសមុទ្រគ្រប់ល្ងាយ.វាមានន័យ។យើងគួរយកអ្វីទៅលើកមុន?ទឹក, អាហារ, ទិសសក និងវត្ថុស្រស់។តម្លៃក្រុមធ្វើការញឹកញាប់ប៉ុណ្ណា?ចំនួនពីរលើសប Minggu, និងច្រើនជាងមុនមុនការប្រកួត។ចាប់បានកុំព្យូទ័ររបស់អ្នកវិញហើយដែរឬទេ?ទេ, ការធ្វើសំរាប់បានដោះស្រាយ។យើងគួរទិញផ្លែនៅផ្សារដែរឬទេ?ទេ, យើងបានប្រមូលកាបូបសំរាមជាច្រើន។ថ្លែងអរគុណសម្រាប់ការជួយថ្ងៃនេះ។មិនមានអ្វីទេ។ ជួបគ្នាស្បែក។វាមានន័យ។អត្ថបទលំហើញនេះមានន័យអ្វី?វាមានន័យថា ទម្រង់មិនអាចរកឃើញ។ខ្ញុំមិនស Solids ដូច្នេះទេ។អ្នកដែលបានព្យាករភាសាទីពីរដែរឬទេ?ទេ, ខ្ញុំលេងតិចៗ មួយថ្ងៃជាមួយកម្មវិធី។ដូចគ្នាដែរ.អ្នកបានទៅកន្លែងណាសម្រាប់ថ្ងៃបុណ្យ?យើងបានទៅទស្សនាភ្នំ.តើអ្នកមកចូលរួមក្រុមសិក្សានៅយប់នេះទេ?ខ្ញុំចង់, ប៉ុន្តែខ្ញុំត្រូវធ្វើការរហូតដល់យប់.អ្នកពេញចិត្តនឹងកម្មវិធីាលៅពីមុនដែរឬទេ?ខ្លាំងណាស់។ ខ្សែភ្លេងគឺពិតជាអស្ចារ្យ។ការដឹកជញ្ជូនសាធារណៈ គឺថ្លៃជាងបើកយានយន្ត ទេ?ជាធម្មតា, ហើយក៏ល្អសម្រាប់បរិស្ថានផងដែរ។ហេតុអ្វីការទំនាក់ទំនងល្អក៏សំខាន់ដែរ?ព្រោះការយល់ច្រឡំអាចបំផ្លាញបាន។ច្បាស់ទេ? ខ្ញុំមិនដឹងទេ។តើអ្នកបានឃើញកម្មវិធីថ្មីសម្រាប់សប្តាហ៍ក្រោយ?

items.text: ပင်လယ်မှာ ရေစီးကြောင်းတွေကို ဘာက ဖြစ်စေတာလဲ။အဓိကအားဖြင့်တော့ တိမ်က ရေပေါ်မှာ ဆွဲအားပေးတာပါ။သင်က အလုပ်သွားချိန်မှာ ဘီးစီးပြီး သွားလေ့ရှိလား။မျှန်တုန်ကောင်းတဲ့အခါမျိုးမှာ သွားတတ်ပါတယ်။အနီးမှာ ကောင်းတဲ့ ဈာတ်ကောင်ဆိုင်ကို လမ်းညွှန်းပေးနိုင်မလား။ထောင့်မှာရှိတဲ့ အသေးတဲ့ဆိုင်က အရသာ ကောင်းတဲ့ အန်တီဖူးတွေကို ရောင်းပါတယ်။ဟင်းသီးဟင်းရွက်ဈေးနှုန်းတွေ တက်လာတဲ့အကြောင်း ဘာကြောင့်လဲ။နွေရာသီက အရမ်းခြောက်သွတ်ခဲ့လို့ ထွက်နှုန်းနည်းခဲ့ပါတယ်။ကျွန်တော်တို့ ဈေးမှာ သီးသန့် ဝယ်သင့်လား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ ဈေးမှာရှိတဲ့ သီးသန့်တွေက စူပါမားကက်မှာရှိတဲ့ သီးသန့်တွေထက် ပို၍ သန့်ရှင်းသပ်ရပ်ပါတယ်။သိပ္ပံပြပွဲတွင် သင်က ဘာကို သင်ယူခဲ့ရသလဲ။ရိုးဘော့များသည် အထုပ်များကို အလွန်လျင်မြန်စွာ စီစစ်နိုင်ပုံ။သင်က ဘာကြောင့် တွဲတောင်းသင်ယူစဉ်အတွင်း အချိန်ယူခဏယူရတာလဲ။တိုတောင်းသော အချိန်ယူခဏများသည် ကျွန်မအနေဖြင့် ပို၍ကြာကြာ စိတ်ဝင်စားနိုင်စေရန် ကူညီပေးသည်။ဒီပရိုဂရမ်မှာ ကျွန်တော်က သင့်ကို ကူညီနိုင်မလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့။ အရင်ဆုံး အမှားအကြောင်းကြားစာကို ကျွန်တော်ကို ပြပါ။အိမ်မှာ အမြဲတမ်း အစားအသောက် လုပ်လေ့ရှိလား။အများအားဖြင့် နေ့တိုင်းပါ။ ဒါက ကျန်းမာရေးအတွက် ကောင်းပြီး ဈေးလည်းသက်သာပါတယ်။နေအကာက ဘယ်လို ဓာတ်အားထုတ်တာလဲ။ဒါက နေရောင်ကို တိုက်ရိုက် ဓာတ်အားအဖြစ် ပြောင်းလဲပေးပါတယ်။ကြီးမားသော အဖွဲ့အစည်းတစ်ခုတွင် အလုပ်လုပ်ရန် ခက်ခက်ခဲခဲလား။အချို့အကြိမ်များတွင် ဖြစ်နိုင်သော်လည်း၊ တိကျသော အခန်းကဏ္ဍများသည် ပို၍လွယ်ကူစေသည်။ဒီအပတေးတွင် မိုးရမလား။မျှော်လင့်ချက်အရ တနင်္လာနေ့တွင် မိုးရိပ်နည်းနည်း ရှိမည်ဟု မျှော်လင့်ထားသည်။ဒီနေ့က ကောင်းမလား။ကောင်းမွန်ပါတယ်။ ကျေးဇူးတင်ပါတယ်။ အိပ်ခြင်းက တကယ်ကို ကူညီပေးပါတယ်။ဒီနေ့က အင်တာနက် ဘာကြောင့် နှေးလိုက်တာလဲ။မုန်တိုင်းကြောင့် အဆိုပါဒေသရှိ ကြိုးလိုင်းအချို့ ပျက်စီးသွားသည်။ကျွန်တော်တို့ အစည်းအဝေးကို မွန်းတည့်ချိန်သို့ ပြောင်းနိုင်မလား။ကျွန်တော်က အဆင်သင့်ပါတယ်။ ကျွန်တော် အခြားသူတွေကို ပြောပြပေးမယ်။သင်က ပန်းခြံမှာ ဘောလုံးကစားချင်လား။တစ်ကယ်လို့ပဲ၊ အခုချိန်က အေးဆေးတဲ့အခါမှာ ကစားချင်တယ်။တွဲဖက်ပါမ professor သည် ချိန်သတ်မှတ်ချက်များကို တင်းကြပ်စွာ လိုက်နာစေလေ့ရှိပါသလား။တင်းကြပ်စွာ လိုက်နာစေလေ့ရှိပါသည်၊ ထို့ကြောင့် အချိန်မီ ပေးသွင်းခြင်းမရှိသော အရာများကို မပေးသွင်းမီ သတိထားပါ။သင်က ငွေကြေးတွေကို ဘယ်လို စီမံခန့်ခွဲပြီး စီးပွားဖြစ်အောင် လုပ်နိုင်လဲ။ကျွန်တော်က အနည်းငယ်ကိုပဲ အပတ်တိုင်း စီးဆင်းထားပါတယ်။အင်းလေးက ဒီနေရာက ဘယ်လောက်က ကွာလဲ။ခရီးသွားဖို့ အနည်းဆုံး တစ်နာရီလောက် ကွာပါတယ်။သင်သည် ရထားဖြင့် သို့မဟုတ် ဘတ်စ်ကားဖြင့် သွားခဲ့သလား။ရထားဖြင့် သွားခဲ့သည်။ ၎င်းသည် ပျော်ရွှင်မှုနှင့် မြန်ဆန်သောကြောင့် ဖြစ်သည်။နောက်ထပ် ဘတ်စ်ကားက ဘယ်အချိန် ထွက်သွားမှာလဲ။ဆယ် မိနစ်လောက်ကြာမှာပဲ၊ တဲလမ်းဘက်မှာရှိတဲ့ ဘတ်စ်ကားရပ်ကွက်ကနေ ထွက်သွားမှာပါ။ညဘက်က ကောင်းကောင်း အိပ်ပျော်ခဲ့လား။မကောင်းခဲ့ပါဘူး။ အိမ်နီးအနားက လူတွေက သံသပ္ကို ကစားနေကြပါတယ်။နေ့စဉ် ဘယ်လောက် ရေ သောက်လဲ။လုံလောက်ပါးပါး မဟုတ်ပါဘူး၊ ကျွန်တော်က ပို၍ သောက်သင့်ပါတယ်။သင်က ပန်းခြံထဲမှာ ဘာတွေကို စိုက်ပျိုးထားလဲ။အပေါ်ထပ်တဲမှာ ဟင်းသီးနှိုက်စိုက်ထားပါတယ်။တောင်ပေါ်လမ်းတွေ ဆောင်းတွင်းမှာ ပွင့်နေလား။မဟုတ်ပါဘူး၊ ဒါတွေက များသောအားဖြင့် ဆောင်းတွင်းမှာ ဆူတေကြောင့် ပိတ်ထားပါတယ်။ခြင်္ကောင်တွေက ဘာကြောင့် အရေးကြီးတာလဲ။ခြင်္ကောင်တွေက ကျွန်တော်တို့အတွက် အသီးနဲ့ ဟင်းသီးဟင်းရွက်တွေကို ထုတ်ပေးတဲ့ အပင်တွေကို ပွင့်ပွင်အောင် လုပ်ပေးပါတယ်။တစ်နေ့က တစ်လုံးအိမ် ဝယ်ချင်လဲ။အဆင်သင့်ဖြစ်နိုင်ပေမယ့် လက်ရှိမှာ ငှားရမ်းနေတာက ပို၍ ကောင်းပါတယ်။သင့်ကွန်ပျူတာက ပြန်လည်အလုပ်လုပ်နေပြီလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ အပ်ဒိတ်လုပ်ပေးလိုက်တော့ ပြဿနာကို ဖြေရှင်းပေးပါတယ်။သင်သည် နွေရာသီခရီးစဥ်ကို နေရာက ဘယ်သို့ သွားခဲ့သလဲ။ကျွန်ုပ်တို့သည် တောင်တန်းအနီးရှိ ငြိမ်သက်သော ကျေးရွာတစ်ရွာသို့ သွားခဲ့သည်။သင်ယူရန် အချိန်ယူခဲ့ရသလား။များသောအားဖြင့် ညနေပိုင်းအထိ ယူခဲ့ရပြီး၊ စတင်ချိန်၌မှားခဲ့သောကြောင့် ဖြစ်သည်။ယနေ့မနက်ပိုင်းက ဟောပြောပွဲကို ဘယ်လိုမြင်ခဲ့လဲ။စိတ်ဝင်စားဖွယ်ကောင်းခဲ့ပြီး၊ အထူးသဖြင့် ဒေတာသင်ယူခြင်းအပိုင်းသည် အရေးကြီးခဲ့သည်။သင်က တစ်ခါတစ်လေ ပင်လယ်ထဲမှာ ငါးကြီးတွေကို မြင်ဖူးလား။တစ်ခါကပဲ၊ ပင်လယ်ပြင်မှာ ဝင်္စင်တစ်ခုပေါ်ကနေ မြင်ရတယ်။သင်က သင့်အလုပ်မှာ ဘာကို အများဆုံးနှစ်သက်တာလဲ။ကောင်းမွန်တဲ့ ဆက်သွယ်ရေးရှိတဲ့ အဖွဲ့တစ်ခုနဲ့အတူ အလုပ်လုပ်တာကို နှစ်သက်ပါတယ်။သင်က အလုပ်သစ်မှာ ပထမနေ့က ဘယ်လိုရှိခဲ့လဲ။တက်ကြွခဲ့ပေမဲ့၊ ကျွန်တော့်ကို အလုပ်အတူလုပ်တဲ့သူတွေက ကောင်းမွန်တဲ့သူတွေပါ။သင်က ပုဏ္ဍကောင်ကို ဘယ်နေရာက တည် Adoption လုပ်ခဲ့လဲ။မြို့ရဲ့အစွန်းမှာရှိတဲ့ တိရိစ္စံအကာအကူဌာနကနေရပါတယ်။မနေ့က သင်က နေဝင်ချိန်ကို မြင်ခဲ့ပါသလား။ဟုတ်ပါတယ်။ နေရာတစ်လျှောက်လုံးမှာ အညိုရောင်နဲ့ ပန်းရောင်တွေ ဖြစ်နေပါတယ်။သင်အတွက် အကြိုက်ဆုံးရာသီက ဘာလဲ။အရာနှင့် အရွက်များ ရောင်အသွေး ပြောင်းလဲချိန်ဖြစ်သော ဆောင်းဦးကာလ။စစ်ဆေးမှုမေးပွဲမတိုင်မီ ဘယ်နေရာတွင် တွေ့ဆုံသင့်မည်။ကောင်တာတစ်ခုတွင် အနည်းငယ်စော၍ တွေ့ဆုံကြရအောင်။ကျွန်တော်တို့က တောင်ပေါ်မှာ လှည့်လည်သွားဖို့ ဘာတွေကို ယူသင့်ပါသလဲ။ရေ၊ အစားအစာ၊ မြေပုံနဲ့ ပွတ်ပတ်ရှည်တဲ့ အဝတ်တစ်ထည်ကို ယူသင့်ပါတယ်။ယနေ့ ကျွန်ုပ်အား ကူညီပေးမှုအတွက် ကျေးဇူးတင်ပါသည်။ဧည့်ခံပါသည်။ နောက်ပတ်တွင် တွေ့ကြပါမည်။သင့်ရဲ့ ဖိုင်တွေကို ဘယ်ကူးထားလဲ။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ ကျွန်တော်က အမြဲတမ်း အခြားဒရိုက်တစ်ခုမှာ ကူးထားပါတယ်။အသစ်ဖွင့်ထားတဲ့ အနုပညာပြခန်းကို သွားဖူးပါသလား။မသွားရသေးပေမယ့်၊ အထင်အမြင်ကောင်းတဲ့ ပန်းချီကားတွေကို တွေ့ရမယ်လို့ ကြားပါတယ်။ညဘက်က တေးသံပွဲကို ကောင်းမလား။တကယ်ကို ကောင်းပါတယ်။ တေးဂီတအဖွဲ့က တော်ဝင်ပါတယ်။ညနေခင်းမှာ သို့မဟုတ် ညနေခင်းအလုပ်ပြီးတဲ့နောက်မှာ အားကစား လုပ်လေ့ရှိလား။များသောအားဖြင့် မနက်ပိုင်းမှာ၊ ညနေခင်းမှာ အလုပ်စလုပ်ခင်မှာပါ။ဒီနေ့ မွန်းတည့်ချိန်မှာ ကလေးတွေ ဘာလုပ်နေလဲ။သူတို့က ကျောင်းရှေ့မှာ ဆောင်းရာသီပုံ တစ်ခုကို ဆောက်နေပါတယ်။လေဆိပ်က မြို့ရဲ့ အလယ်ဗဟိုက ကွာလား။မဟုတ်ပါဘူး၊ ရထားက မိနစ်ခွဲဝက်လောက်ပဲကြာပါတယ်။သင်သည် ပျမ်းမျှကမ်းခြေသန့်ရှင်းရေးတွင် ပါဝင်ခဲ့ပါသလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ ကျွန်ုပ်တို့သည် အမှိုက်အိတ်အများအပြားကို စုဆောင်းခဲ့ပါသည်။ဒီအမှားအကြောင်းကြားစာက ဘာကို ဆိုတာလဲ။ဒါက ဖိုင်တစ်ခုကို မတွေ့နိုင်ဘူးဆိုတာကို ဆိုပါတယ်။အစိုးရက ဘာကြေညာထားလဲ။နယ်စပ်ဒေသရှိ လမ်းများကို တိုးတက်စေရန်အတွက် အစီအစဉ်သစ်တစ်ခုကို ကြေညာထားသည်။ဒီနေ့ညမှာ ဘာစားချင်လဲ။အဆန်အသင့်စားရမယ့် အစားအစာမျိုးပေါ့၊ အထုပ်ကြော်နဲ့ အသစ်ထောင်းထားတဲ့ ခမီးရောင်ပေါင်မုန့်မျိုးပေါ့။ခမီးရောင်ပေါင်မုန့် လုပ်နည်းကို ဘယ်သူက သင်ပေးခဲ့လဲ။ကျွန်မရဲ့ မျက်မှန်တော်က ကျွန်မ ငယ်တုန်းက သင်ပေးခဲ့ပါတယ်။ဆရာဝန်က သင့်ကို အကြံပြုချက်တွေ ပေးခဲ့ပါသလား။သူမက ကျွန်မကို အိပ်ရအောင်နဲ့ ရေ သောက်ရအောင် ပြောခဲ့ပါတယ်။ယနေ့အတွက် အခန်းကို ဖတ်ပြီးပြီလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ ကျွန်တော်က ယမန်နေ့ညက ဖတ်ခဲ့ပြီးပြီ၊ သို့သော် ဒုတိယပိုင်းသည် ခက်ခက်ခဲခဲခဲ့သည်။အပြင်မှာ ဥတုက မဖြစ်မဖြစ်သလို ရှိပါသလား။ဥတုသည် အေးနှင့် လေတိုက်သဖြင့်၊ ပွင့်လင်းသော အထည်အလိပ်ကို ဝတ်ဆင်ထားပါ။အင်ဂျင်နီယာများသည် ကားများကို လျင်မြန်စွာ အင်အားသုံးစွဲမှု လျှော့ချနိုင်အောင် ဘယ်လိုလုပ်နိုင်သလဲ။၎င်းတို့ကို ပို၍ပေါ့ပါးစေပြီး ပို၍ထိရောက်အောင် လုပ်ခြင်းဖြင့် ဖြစ်သည်။သင့်အဖွဲ့က ဒီနေ့ စနေနေ့က မဲပွဲကို အနိုင်ရခဲ့လား။ဟုတ်တယ်၊ ကျွန်တော်တို့က နောက်ဆုံး မိနစ်ပိုင်းမှာ အနိုင်ရပါတယ်။ဘယ်လိုမျိုး သီချင်းတွေကို ကြိုက်လဲ။များသောအားဖြင့် ငြိမ်းအေးတဲ့ သီချင်းတွေကို ကြိုက်ပါတယ်။ ဒါတွေက ကျွန်တော်ကို ပျော်ရွှင်စေပါတယ်။ဒုတိယ ဘာသာစကား သင်ယူဖူးပါသလား။ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ ကျွန်တော်က နေ့တိုင်း တစ်နေ့နည်းနည်းကို အက်ပ်တစ်ခုနဲ့ လေ့ကျင့်ပါတယ်။ယနေ့ညတွင် သင်ယူရန် အုပ်စုသို့ လာမည်လား။ကျွန်တော်ကလည်း လာချင်ပေမယ့် ညနေပိုင်းထိ လုပ်ရသေးသည်။ဘာကြောင့် ပျံသန်းခရီးက တိတ်တိတ်ရပ်သွားတာလဲ။မနက်ပိုင်းမှာ လေထုတစ်ဝက်လွှမ်းခြုံထားတဲ့အတွက်ပါ။ကျွန်ုပ်တို့ ပြီးဆုံးရန် မတိုင်မီ အဓိကအချက်များကို ပြန်လည်သုံးသပ်သင့်ပါသလား။ကောင်းမွန်သော အကြံပြုချက်ဖြစ်သည်။ ကျွန်ုပ်တို့သည် ၎င်းတို့ကို တစ်ခုချင်းစီကို ကြည့်ရှုကြပါစို့။ကျွန်ုပ်တို့သည် စာမေးပွဲအတွင်း မှတ်ချက်များကို အသုံးပြုခွင့် ရှိပါသလား။မရှိပါ၊ ပြီးတော့ ဖုန်းများကိုလည်း ပိတ်ထားရမည်ဖြစ်သည်။
